A key part of your role will be upskilling our support staff on German market workflows, participant journeys, and exception handling – ensuring the whole team can operate confidently as we grow our German footprint.

What You’ll Do

Market Operations

- Apply working knowledge of the German energy regulatory landscape (BNetzA, BDEW) to day-to-day operational tasks.
- Manage and resolve data flow exceptions relating to MaKo/EDIFACT messaging, GPKE, and WiM processes, and MSB/VNB interactions.
- Support the accurate management of MaLo and MeLo data, ensuring data integrity across systems.
- Work within the MsbG metering framework and support smart meter rollout processes relevant to VPP-connected assets.
- Demonstrate solid understanding of MaBis processes.
- Monitor Bilanzkreis and settlement obligations relevant to our flexible asset portfolio in Germany.Flexibility Participant & Exception Management
- Act as the primary handler for escalated exceptions arising from the German flexibility participant journey – from asset registration through to settlement and payment queries.
- Own complex cases end-to-end, coordinating across internal teams (settlements, tech, finance) to reach resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and escalate systemic root causes with clear data and recommended fixes.
- Support onboarding of new German flexibility participants and asset owners, ensuring a smooth and compliant process.Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Design and deliver structured training sessions for UK-based support staff covering German market processes, regulatory obligations, and participant workflows.
- Build and maintain clear, practical playbooks, process guides, and FAQs for use by the wider support team.
- Conduct regular knowledge gap assessments and adjust training content accordingly.
- Review training effectiveness and iterate based on team performance and feedback.Process Improvement & Efficiency
- Actively identify manual or repetitive tasks and find ways to reduce effort through process redesign or tooling.
- Maintain up-to-date process documentation in a clear, accessible format.
- Flag regulatory or process changes in the German market that may impact operations and recommend responses.

What You’ll Bring

Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical working knowledge across most of the following:

- BNetzA regulatory framework and BDEW market rules
- MaKo communication standards and EDIFACT message types
- GPKE (supplier switching) and WiM (metering point management) processes
- MsbG obligations and the role of the Messstellenbetreiber (MSB)
- MaLo (market location) and MeLo (metering location) data structures
- Bilanzkreis management and balancing group settlement
- German electricity billing structures including Netzentgelte and Grundversorgung vs. competitive supply frameworks
- Direktvermarktung framework
- MaBis processes for balancing group settlement reconciliation
- FCR/aFRR/mFFR prequalification and flexibility market participation rules (desirable)Essential
- Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), with experience communicating with German counterparts and producing documentation in both languages
- Demonstrable hands-on experience working within the German energy market at an operational level (a minimum of 3 years)
- Proven ability to manage exceptions and complex operational cases end-to-end
- Experience designing and delivering training or knowledge transfer programmes
- Strong analytical mindset with a practical, solutions-first approach
- Comfortable working autonomously and picking up tasks without needing close directionDesirable
- Experience with MaKo-compliant systems or EDIFACT messaging tools
- Knowledge of MSB obligations and smart meter rollout processes in Germany
- Experience working across multiple European energy markets
- Experience in a scale-up or market entry environment

What to Expect

Tesla Energy is
deploying the world’s largest fleet of battery energy storage systems (BESS)
from residential Powerwall to grid-scale Megapack, across dozens of markets
worldwide. Regulatory safety certification is the gate between engineering and
the market.

As a Regulatory Safety
Engineer you will be the in-house expert on product safety standards and
market-entry regulations for BESS and supporting power electronics. You will
translate complex normative requirements such as IEC, UL, CSA, EN, and beyond
into engineering design specifications, then drive products through
certification from first design review to certificate issue. You will work
alongside hardware, power electronics, firmware, and systems engineers, making
compliance a design and integral part of the process.

What You’ll Do

- Research and maintain a living map of market-entry requirements for BESS and ancillary equipment across North America, Europe, Australia, and emerging markets; interpret and apply applicable codes, regulations, and directives. 
- Horizon-scan for new and evolving standards affecting BESS products and communicate regulatory risk to engineering and programme leadership. 
- Develop Compliance Product Design Requirements (CPDRs) translating normative requirements into unambiguous engineering specifications, covering product-specific standards (IEC 62619, IEC 62933 series, IEC 62109/62477 series, UL 9540/9540A, UL 1741, UL 1973), and fundamental safety principles such as IEC 60664 series insulation coordination, IEC 60990 touch current, and IEC 60529 IP ratings. 
- Lead design reviews to identify compliance gaps and safety risks early; propose and track engineering solutions to closure. 
- Own CE marking end-to-end: conformity assessment route selection, technical file compilation, Declaration of Conformity (DoC) drafting, and Notified Body or competent authority liaison. 
- Define and manage certification strategies across global schemes such as UL/cUL (NRTL), CB Scheme (IECEE), CE marking, AS/NZS, and others as markets are entered, and author test plans and lead testing in-house and at accredited third-party laboratories. 
- Debug certification failures, root-cause anomalies, and propose design and/or test-method solutions; review test reports and manage certificate lifecycles, surveillance audits, and re-certification triggered by engineering changes. 
- Act as the regulatory safety SME for cross-functional engineering teams; support field compliance escalations and post-market surveillance; build internal knowledge bases and mentor junior engineers on regulatory processes and certification strategy. 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent; 5+ years in product safety certification for power electronics or energy storage products. 
- Proven CE marking expertise: technical file construction, DoC preparation, and Notified Body liaison; hands-on BESS and power electronics certification experience across IEC and UL standards (IEC 62619, 62933, 62109/62477, UL 9540, UL 1741, UL 1973).

PhD-Student (m/f/d)

Join an interdisciplinary research project at the interface of neurobiology, RNA biology, and bioinformatics. The aim of this PhD project is to decipher the regulatory mechanisms underlying RNA dysregulation in response to environmental and viral stressors. Using innovative brain organoid models, you will apply computational and experimental approaches to investigate the effects of microplastics and/or HSV-1 infections on RNA regulation in models of Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls. The insights gained are expected to contribute to a better understanding of the development and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

As part of this PhD project, you will employ state-of-the-art sequencing and analytical techniques to investigate how environmental factors and viral infections influence RNA regulation in the human brain. Particular emphasis will be placed on understanding the molecular mechanisms that may contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

- Analyze alterations in RNA regulation in the human brain using single-cell transcriptomics and long-read RNA sequencing.
- Investigate key RNA regulatory processes, including alternative splicing, RNA isoform usage, polyadenylation dynamics, and transposable element activity.
- Explore the effects of HSV-1 infections and genetic risk factors on RNA isoform diversity and regulation.
- Integrate and analyze transcriptomic and epitranscriptomic datasets to identify disease-relevant molecular mechanisms.
- Compare data from human brain organoid models with datasets from Alzheimer’s disease patients to assess the disease relevance of the models.
- Develop and apply bioinformatics approaches for the analysis of complex multi-omics datasets.
- Present and discuss research findings within the team and at national and international scientific conferences.
- Contribute to scientific publications in leading international peer-reviewed journals.
- Opportunity to expand the project to additional molecular layers, including proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics.
- Completed Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Neuroscience, or a related field.
- Strong enthusiasm for RNA biology and research into neurodegenerative diseases.
- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Analysis of RNA sequencing and other omics datasets (bulk, single-cell, and/or long-read data)
- Programming and data analysis, particularly using Python and/or R
- Ability to work independently in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
- Strong teamwork and communication skills, with enthusiasm for collaborating in interdisciplinary and international research environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Desirable Qualifications

- Experience in the analysis of RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, or epitranscriptomic datasets.
- Knowledge of multi-omics data integration and analysis.
- Interest in organoid models and translational biomedical research.

We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.

Our products:

-Incorporate high-speed embedded hardware as well as high power circuitry - providing a smart interconnection of power sources to electrical cars for charging purposes
-Satisfy high quality needs in terms of user friendliness and versatile application
-Provide an ecosystem for EV users making them independent from grid charges 

With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!

Your area of responsibility

- Transformation of high-level product ideas into hardware concepts - together with product owners, software and mechanical design engineers 
- Conception of complete devices in tight collaboration with product owners, software and mechanical design engineers 
- Development and simulation of circuit and PCB design as essential core of the devices using EDA tools
- Initial operation and verification of circuitry - with documentation of performance results
- Integration of the device in close collaboration with the software team
- Creation of test plans for PCBA and device manufacturing 
- Provision of full documentation set for PCBA manufacturing (Gerber, etc.)
- Maintenance for devices in the field (discontinued parts, etc.)

- At least 3 years of professional experience in the field
- University degree in electronic/electrical engineering or similar education (technician, dual education, etc.)
- Significant professional experience with Altium designer or another EDA tool
- Basic knowledge of digital circuit design/principles
- Experience with the design of analog circuits
- Familiarity with populating a PCB and using lab equipment 
- Empathy towards your colleagues with a collaborative mindset
- Ability to work with little oversight and independent decision-making
- Fluency in spoken and written English

It would be even better if you have

- Familiarity with the concepts of EMC and EMI
- Experience with HDI PCB Design
- Experience with cellular basebands and smartphone SoCs
- Experience with SI/PI Simulation or willingness to learn
- Experience with Keysight ADS

What we offer

- Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
- A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
- Flexible working hours
- Mental well-being support
- Employee discounts on our products
- Corporate discounts on a variety of brands

We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy  (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The **Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) **and the University of Augsburg are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in CAR-T Cell Therapy and Therapeutic Target Discovery in Pediatric and Rare Tumors to join our interdisciplinary research program at the interface of pediatric oncology, tumor biology, cellular therapy, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology. The position is a full-time position which is limited to two years.

The Children’s Hospital Augsburg (Swabian Children’s Cancer Center) is part of University Hospital Augsburg (UKA), a rapidly growing academic medical center with 1,699 patient beds across 22 clinics and approximately 2,800 employees. Scientifically, the hospital is a member of the NCT-WERA cooperation and thus one location of the National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT).

**Research Environment **

- Single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic technologies are providing unprecedented opportunities to characterize tumor composition, heterogeneity, and evolution. Our research program combines these approaches with experimental tumor modeling to identify clinically actionable vulnerabilities in rare and high-risk tumors
- Our group has established a strong track record in the molecular characterization of pediatric and rare tumors, including rhabdoid tumors and other embryonal malignancies. Recent integrative studies have provided new insights into the biology and evolution of these tumors and opened avenues for therapeutic translation (Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2016; Erkek, Johann et al., Cancer Cell, 2019; Fincke et al., Clinical Cancer Research, 2023; Mucha et al., Communications Medicine, 2025; Fincke et al., Nature Communications, 2026, accepted)
- A central goal of this position is the identification, prioritization, and experimental validation of therapeutic targets in rare entities for which effective treatment options remain limited. Relevant tumor types include DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, pediatric and rare melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- The successful candidate will combine molecular and computational analyses with state-of-the-art experimental approaches. CAR-T-cell therapy will represent a major experimental platform for evaluating candidate cell-surface targets and developing targeted cellular therapies
- Together with our partner institutions, we are establishing a growing biobank of patient-derived tumor organoids and other advanced tumor models, enabling systematic investigation of target expression, therapeutic efficacy, and mechanisms of resistance, including in vivo

**Your Responsibilities **

- Identify and prioritize novel therapeutic targets using integrated molecular, single-cell, spatial, and multi-omic data
- Experimentally validate candidate targets using patient-derived models, organoids, and cell lines
- Generate, engineer, and functionally characterize CAR-T cells
- Develop and optimize CAR constructs and cellular therapy strategies
- Evaluate CAR-T-cell efficacy and mechanisms of resistance in vitro and, ideally, in vivo
- Integrate experimental results with bioinformatic and computational analyses
- Develop independent research projects and contribute to grants and collaborative projects
- Publish and present research findings
- Mentor students and junior researchers where appropriate

Requirements

Mandatory

- PhD or equivalent degree in biology, molecular medicine, cancer biology, immunology, biotechnology, or a related field
- Hands-on experience in CAR-T-cell generation, engineering, and functional characterization
- Strong background in experimental cancer or cellular biology
- Experience in independent experimental research and data analysis
- Strong interest in therapeutic target discovery and translational cancer research
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills
- Excellent written and spoken English

Highly desirable

- Experience with therapeutic in vivo testing of CAR-T cells and/or xenograft models
- Experience with tumor organoids or patient-derived models
- Expertise in CAR design, viral transduction, T-cell expansion, flow cytometry, or functional immune-cell assays
- Experience in therapeutic target discovery and validation
- Familiarity with single-cell, spatial, or multi-omic approaches
- Programming skills in R or Python

What we offer

- Remuneration up to pay grade EG 13 TV-L, depending on qualifications and professional experience, including the standard social benefits provided in the public sector (occupational pension scheme and annual special payment)
- The position is initially limited to two years; an extension is intended, subject to funding and successful performance
- An interdisciplinary research environment combining experimental oncology, CAR-T-cell engineering, therapeutic target discovery, and computational cancer biology
- Integration into the research program of the University of Augsburg, with close collaboration with the University Hospital Augsburg and computational research groups
- The opportunity to work on rare and clinically challenging tumor entities, including DICER1-associated neoplasms, rhabdoid tumors, melanomas, and other high-risk pediatric malignancies
- Access to advanced patient-derived tumor models, including a growing collection of tumor organoids
- Opportunities to develop an independent academic profile, publish, present at international conferences, and contribute to grant applications
- International collaborations and opportunities for research visits with academic partner institutions

Contact

For further questions please refer to Prof. Dr. Pascal Johann (Pascal.Johann@uk-augsburg.de)

Application Deadline

Please submit your application as soon as possible, latest at the 15th of October 2026.

We look forward to you!

The position is suitable for people with severe disabilities. Applicants (m/f/d) with severe disabilities will be preferred if they are essentially the same aptitude, ability and professional performance. Women are invited to apply in accordance with Article 7 (3) BayGlG. When starting work at the Augsburg University Hospital, proof of sufficient immune protection in accordance with §§ 23, 23a IfSG must be presented or the same must be met.

With its groundbreaking industrial and commercial setup and its unique certification and flexibility, European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) showcases how European industry can find innovative ways to support strategic autonomy needs and prepare for the Future Combat Air System. The Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science (Max Planck Gesellschaft, MPG) is a self-governing scientific organization funded by the Federal and State Governments. It conducts basic research in the fields of natural sciences, the humanities and the social sciences in 85 institutes and research units in Germany and abroad.

The MPG consists of three sections: the Biology and Medicine Section, the Chemistry, Physics and Technology Section and the Human Sciences Section. Each section has a Scientific Scouting Officer who supports the respective section and its institutes in identifying the next generation of leading researchers.

For the Human Sciences Section, the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG are now seeking a:

Scientific Scouting Officer (all genders) -

80% part-time initially, with a potential full-time transition effective 1 January 2029

(Reference Number 63/26)

to start as early as possible.

The Section includes a range of disciplines, notably the History of Art, Anthropology, Demography, Economics, the History of Science, Law, Neurosciences, Political Sciences, Psychology, and Sociology.

Analyzing candidate lists generated through nomination calls
Implementing, maintaining and further developing candidate databases together with the two Scouting Officers of the other section
Attending international conferences, participating in public outreach to promote the MPG
Complementing the current scouting team and actively participating in constantly developing the team’s scouting concept, tackling human sciences-oriented as well as interdisciplinary scouting projects

Doctoral degree in one of the scientific disciplines of the Human Sciences Section and several years of postdoctoral experience
Education and/or postdoctoral research abroad, ideally for several years
In-depth knowledge of the German and international research landscape (including organizational and research-specific framework conditions)
Proven scientific track record and demonstrated knowledge of the respective scientific community
General interest in a broad range of scientific subjects covered in the Human Sciences Section and ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new areas of research
Solution-oriented, service-driven, creative and open-minded working style
Excellent proficiency in English (written and spoken, level C1-C2) and good proficiency in German (minimum level B2)
Excellent interpersonal communication and networking skills, in order to interact with and coordinate partners with diverse professional and multicultural backgrounds
Experience in working with AI applications or a willingness to learn how to use such systems
Willingness to adopt flexible working hours, as well as taking part in regular business travel in Germany and abroad
Experience in scouting/recruiting scientists would be desirable

You will gain fascinating insights into the outstanding research at our Max Planck Institutes.
You will help to identify the next generation of outstanding scientists for the MPG by directly interacting with its leadership and directors.
As a member of the Section Office, you will cooperate with the department "Institutes" at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG.
You will obtain an excellent overview of the entire spectrum of scientific administration and the structure of the German research landscape.

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

- You'll work in close collaboration with cross-functional teams and play an important role in ensuring that clinical trial supplies meet the highest quality and regulatory standards before reaching patients around the world.

Education:

- Completed vocational training as PTA, PKA, CTA, Pharmaceutical Assistant or a comparable qualification

Experience:

- Quality Assurance or Quality Control within the pharmaceutical industry
- Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
- Previous exposure to documentation management, batch release or clinical supply operations is an advantage

- Good understanding of GMP/GDP requirements and pharmaceutical quality systems
- Structured, detail-oriented and quality-focused approach to work
- Strong organizational and documentation skills
- Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with SharePoint, TrackWise or eDMS is beneficial
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams
- Fluent German and good English communication skills (written and spoken)

What we offer

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organization

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.

Electricity is becoming the operating system of the world economy. Decarbonized industry, electrified transport and heat, and the computing infrastructure required for artificial intelligence all depend on reliable and innovative electrical products and distribution systems.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on executive to lead our global Research & Development and Technology organization. In this role, you will combine the operational leadership of a large, globally distributed R&D organization with the strategic responsibility for the technology roadmap of Siemens Electrical Products. You will shape the continued development of our strong electromechanical portfolio while accelerating the integration of power electronics, electronics, connectivity, software, and intelligent product capabilities across Europe, India, China, and other international locations. **What will be your role and responsibilities? **
Strategic R&D and Technology Leadership- Define and implement an integrated global R&D and technology strategy across product programs, technology roadmaps, platforms, architectures, and selected exploratory initiatives to strengthen long-term competitiveness and sustainable growth.   - Lead a global R&D and Technology organization of more than 1,000 employees across Europe, India, China, and further international locations, with responsibility for an R&D budget in the triple-digit million-euro range.   - Drive the R&D contribution to the company programs and align technology roadmaps, platform strategies, development priorities, and resource allocation across Electrical Products.    - As a direct report and strategic technology partner to the pre of Electrical Products, you will translate long-term industry and technology trends into clear portfolio, platform, capability, and organizational priorities.

**Technology and Portfolio Development  ** - Shape the future portfolio by further developing the electromechanical product foundation while expanding power-electronics- and semiconductor-based solutions, advancing direct-current architectures, and enabling connected, software-supported products.   - Advance the secure connectivity and IoT strategy and evaluate how data management and artificial intelligence can create measurable customer and product value.   - Lead the evolution toward increasingly connected, intelligent, and updatable products by integrating electronics, communication, software, cybersecurity, and cloud capabilities into a strong electromechanical product portfolio, while ensuring quality and regulatory compliance.   - Embed sustainability into engineering and product decisions by advancing circular and repairable design, eco-design, material efficiency, lower losses, and a reduced product carbon footprint.

R&D Excellence - Lead the global R&D footprint, capacity allocation, capability development, and collaboration across development locations, with clear missions and end-to-end accountability for product development.   - Provide hands-on leadership for the execution of product and development roadmaps, working closely with Product Management to translate market requirements into differentiated, competitive, and technically robust products.   - Remain close to products, laboratories, development teams, and manufacturing environments, enabling fact-based technical decisions and effective problem-solving directly where products are designed and developed.   - Advance platform, architecture, and reuse strategies through modular solutions, virtual validation, and pre-certified building blocks, improving development efficiency, product quality, and time-to-market.   - Modernize R&D through model-based systems engineering, digital continuity from requirements to field data, simulation-led design, and the targeted use of artificial intelligence in R&D processes.   - Strengthen the global R&D environment by harmonizing product lifecycle management tools, increasing platform consistency, and fostering effective collaboration and knowledge sharing across segments and development locations.

You will work regularly at our key development and product locations, with a strong presence in Amberg, Germany, where a significant part of the organization is based. International travel and the flexibility to spend extended periods at global sites are essential.

**What you need to make a difference: **

- An advanced academic degree or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering or a closely related technical field. Candidates with a background in physics may also be considered if they bring extensive professional experience in the electrical or electrification industry. A doctorate is an advantage.   - Extensive professional experience, including significant executive leadership responsibility within large, globally distributed R&D and Engineering organizations spanning multiple development centers and cultures - Deep technical and product experience in electrical engineering, electrification, electromechanical systems, or comparable industrial products, combined with a sound understanding of power electronics, electronics, embedded software, connectivity, and system architecture.   - The ability to combine strategic technology leadership with hands-on operational R&D management and to engage credibly in detailed discussions about products, systems, architectures, and engineering trade-offs.   - A strong track record in transforming R&D organizations, technology portfolios, platforms, architectures, and global engineering capabilities, translated into successful products and measurable business results.   - Experience in managing technology and product portfolios, leading global R&D organizations, overseeing significant innovation investments, and driving strategic make, partner, or buy decisions. - Strong critical thinking and business sense, with the ability to set clear priorities, make evidence-based technology and investment decisions, and discontinue activities that do not support the strategic direction.   - The ability to navigate a complex global matrix, establish clear decision rights, resolve conflicts constructively, and collaborate closely with business leaders, Product Management, manufacturing, quality, and other multi-functional partners.   - Excellent executive communication and partner management skills, combined with the ability to develop senior leaders, technical experts, and successors in a global organization.   - An international approach, fluency in English, and proven experience in leading across countries and cultures. jobs.description:
As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics
related to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their current
situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your

development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and
develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You

portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and

development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)

certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of

liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and

understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as

and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA

jobs.description:
About us

The Max-Planck-Zentrum für Physik und Medizin (MPZPM) is an interdisciplinary joint research center of the Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL), Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU), and Universitätsklinikum Erlangen (UKER). Research at MPZPM addresses fundamental questions in medicine, aiming to understand living systems, biological processes, and their pathological changes from a novel physical perspective.

Facility Leader - Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility at MPZPM
Core Facilities (CF) at MPZPM provide cutting-edge technologies and form an essential part of the center’s scientific infrastructure. The Lab-on-a-Chip (LoC) Facility is equipped with state-of-the-art microfabrication technologies housed within a cleanroom at MPZPM. LoC can also draw on the capabilities of another nanofabrication cleanroom facility at MPL. The unit supports researchers in developing advanced microfluidic chips, microtools and physiologically relevant microenvironments for studies at the interface of physics and medicine. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Facility Head to manage and further develop the Lab-on-a-Chip facility. You will oversee daily operations, ensure safe and efficient laboratory workflows, support scientific users from diverse backgrounds and contribute to the design and development of innovative methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Management

Lead, mentor, and support scientific and technical staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team.
Oversee facility operations, including planning, budgeting, maintenance, and strategic development.
Train and support users from diverse scientific backgrounds.

Technical Expertise & Scientific Support

Ensure reliable operation of cleanroom infrastructure and microfabrication equipment.
Provide expert guidance in microfabrication, microfluidics, and lab-on-a-chip system development.
Contribute to the development of new microstructured materials, microfluidic chips, and advanced LoC technologies.

Innovation & Development

Support interdisciplinary research projects and facilitate knowledge transfer across scientific fields.
Develop novel microfluidics-based methodologies and provide SOPs to ensure reliable and reproducible use.
Propose and discuss organizational and infrastructure improvements with the MPZPM board, focusing on optimized workflows, state-of-the-art technologies, and strategic upgrades aligned with the institute’s priorities.
You bring:

MSc or PhD in physics, biophysics, chemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or a related field.
Experience in managing laboratories, particularly cleanrooms, including staff supervision and operation of microfabrication workflows.
Strong organizational, leadership, and project-management skills, with a track record of building or expanding scientific infrastructure.
Expertise in developing microfluidic technologies.
Capability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines. English is the primary working language; knowledge of German is advantageous.
Experience in technology transfer, device development, or industry collaboration is a plus.

Ideal Technical Competencies (some of the following):

Microfabrication & Lithography: photolithography, soft lithography, micropatterning of rigid and soft materials, biomolecule patterning via microcontact printing or LIMA photopatterning.
Microfluidics & Lab-on-a-Chip Systems: design, production, and integration of microfluidic chips with fluidic, optical and electronic components.
Soft Material Microstructuring: hydrogels, droplet microfluidics, and other soft materials relevant to biomedical applications.
3D structuring using Digital Light Processing (DLP) and Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM).

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the mechanical systems department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Development Engineer (m/f/d) - Mechanical Analysis and Testing of Space Structures

We are seeking creative professionals with deep expertise in structural dynamics to tackle tasks in the mechanical analysis and testing of aerospace structures. The ideal candidate will bring initial professional experience in the mechanical design and verification of aerospace components (such as satellites, instruments, and mechanisms) and is eager to apply and further develop their academic and practical expertise.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facility
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Structural Analysis: Support the execution of static and dynamic structural analyses for aerospace structures, ensuring result plausibility through manual verification methods.
- Performance Analysis: Conduct mechanical performance analyses for high-precision instruments and structures designed for space applications.
- Testing & Simulation: Contribute to the simulation and oversight of vibration testing for satellites and their sub-components.
- FEM Modeling: Develop mathematical structural models using Finite Element Analysis (FEA), focusing on application-oriented structural idealization and physical model validation using Hyperworks and NASTRAN.
- Verification of Joints: Perform strength verification for joining elements in accordance with VDI and ESA standards.
- Tool Development: Assist in developing internal Matlab-based tools for workflow optimization and the processing of analytical and test data.
- Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all processes, specifically regarding mathematical models and analytical/test outcomes.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience: Prior first professional experience in the design and verification of aerospace structures is highly preferred.
- Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in static/dynamic structural analysis (FEM) and manual calculation methods.
- Software Skills: Proficiency in Nastran and Hyperworks.
- Specific Knowledge: Solid understanding of space-specific requirements; experience with fiber-composite structure design and calculation is a plus.
- Soft Skills: A proactive, structured work style with the ability to work both independently and effectively within a team.
- Communication: Excellent communication skills.
- Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory, proficiency in German is an advantage.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

- Selection and qualification of electronic components

- Defining and carrying out hardware tests

- At least 3 years’ experience in hardware development
- Experience in the development of industrial electronic systems
- Experience with product development processes and development standards
- In-depth knowledge of analogue and digital circuit design
- Experience with processor technology and associated peripheral circuits
- Knowledge of the simulation and verification of electronic circuits
- Proficiency in using ECAD tools for schematic design and circuit simulation
- Experience in using electronic measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers and logic analysers
- Ideally, knowledge of EMC-compliant device design

Soft skills:

- Structured and analytical approach to work

- Strong communication skills
- Results-oriented
- Quality-conscious

- German: business fluent
- English: fluent, both spoken and written, for international development projects

Part-time 50 % (20 h/week) to start, potential option to move to full-time after 6 months  · Start as soon as possible · English-speaking role

We help people pipette light. Our optoWELL is a programmable LED illumination platform for 24- and 96-well plates, used by labs worldwide in optogenetics, photopharmacology and photodynamic therapy. We are a small team in Freiburg and sell directly to scientists around the globe. To grow, we need one more person who wants to leave the bench and create a lasting role in our startup with us.

What you will own

- Finding researchers who work with light
- Turning them into qualified leads
- Reaching out, following up, and handing warm conversations over to our CEO
- Keeping the pipeline clean and reporting on it
- A smaller share of routine sales admin (quotes, order confirmations, invoices)

You will not be an assistant. You get a clearly defined area, your own numbers, a documented process to start from – and the freedom to improve it.

What you bring

- Some background in light-based research – or the curiosity to dive into it with us; it is a small, friendly field and we will show you around
- A Master's degree or PhD in biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacy, chemistry or a related field – you can read a paper and pull out what matters
- Excellent written English; German is helpful for day-to-day work but not required
- You enjoy writing short, personal messages and are not discouraged by the fact that most people don't reply
- Structured, self-reliant work over weeks with a weekly check-in rather than daily supervision; solid Excel skills
- Nice to have: experience with CRM tools or AI-assisted literature work

What we offer

- A proven, documented sales process that already works – you copy it first, then improve it and make it your own if you can
- A role built around one measurable outcome – conversations booked with qualified scientists – rather than a to-do list
- Direct work with the founder, short decision paths, real insight into how a scientific instrument is sold worldwide
- Flexible hours, remote days possible after onboarding, office at the Freiburg Innovation Center (FRIZ)
- €21,000– €25,000 for the 50 % part time role depending on experience. €42,000–50,000 gross per year at full-time equivalent  depending on experience – i.e. ; the same rate applies if the role grows to full-time

What we are really looking for

Someone who is curious about other people's science and would rather understand a lab's actual problem than pitch a product. Someone who works on their own steam, says so when something is not working, and treats scientists and colleagues with the same respect. If that sounds like you, this is not a side role – it is a seat at the core of a small team.

How this works

You will work directly with me, Kathrin – co-founder, CEO, and so far the one doing this job. Send me an email with your CV and two or three sentences on why you want to leave the bench (no cover letter please, and no multi-page AI slop): k.brenker@optobiolabs.com. Then it is simple: a short conversation, a  two- to three-hour trial task so we both see what the job actually feels like, and fast feedback – you will hear from me within a week, either way.

jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is looking, starting from December 2026, for a Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for Imaging and Spatial Omics Data.

The core facilities, Single-Cell Open Lab and the Omics IT and Data Management Core Facility (ODCF) at the DKFZ, provide infrastructure and workflows for single-cell and spatial omics projects. To strengthen our teams from September 2026, we are seeking a Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for imaging and spatial omics data within the ID3:bio 2.0 project (https://gerbi-gmb.de/i3dbio/).
ID3:bio 2.0 is a DFG-funded project that aims to deliver tools and strategies for the FAIR management of imaging and spatial omics data. Together with the universities of Düsseldorf and Tübingen, we develop and implement standards for metadata, file formats, data-exchange strategies, and long-term archiving.

Your Tasks

You will work in an interdisciplinary team of software developers, bioinformaticians, system administrators, and wet lab scientists, with software development at the center of your role:

- Develop and extend our GUIDE metadata platform (a Kotlin-based application) to annotate generic (meta)data and to import non-sequencing data types into the ODCF infrastructure
- Design and build the integration of the OMERO imaging platform with genomic data (OTP) within the ODCF infrastructure
- Design and implement user and permission management across the imaging and genomics systems
- Implement metadata schemas and packaging formats such as RO-Crate for spatial data
- Build tools to collect, organize, and validate research (meta)data
- Co-organize and take part in hackathons
- Organize workshops and train users to work in line with the FAIR principles

Your Profile

If you enjoy building software in an interdisciplinary team and want to enable exciting research by easing data flow for more robust and excellent analysis, this position is for you.

- Master's degree (or equivalent qualification and relevant professional experience) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
- Substantial software development experience, including professional proficiency in Kotlin (our GUIDE platform is Kotlin-based) or Java
- Proficiency in at least one further language such as Python or JavaScript
- Experience with system administration, container and cloud technologies, and Linux
- Genuine interest in the biological and life-science background of the data — curiosity is essential, but no prior training in biology is required
- Ability to solve complex problems in a structured, well-documented way together with internal and external partners
- Willingness to explain complex technical workflows to non-specialists
- Very good command of English

Advantageous

- Experience in research data management (omics and/or imaging data)
- Experience with OMERO and imaging data
- Experience with ontologies, RO-Crate, and the SpatialData framework
- Experience in open-source software engineering and HPC
- Experience in organizing hackathons and community engagement

How to apply:

Please provide a motivation letter, CV, and highest education certificate. The motivation letter should clearly state your contribution to the project in reference to the expected skills. Please also state your own key interests and expectations for your role in the project.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level

- Flexible working hours

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

About the Role

This position is for experienced Clinical Research Associates with 2+ years of independent monitoring experience. You will manage clinical trial sites across Germany, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, and company SOPs.

jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics (MPE) in
Garching (near Munich), Germany, is a world-leading institute for
developing and operating state-of-the-art astronomical instruments.
Over the past years, MPE has taken a leading role in the development
of instrumentation for several international space- and ground-based
projects, for example XMM-Newton, Herschel, SRG/eROSITA, EUCLID, the
VLT telescopes (e.g. KMOS, GRAVITY) and Einstein Probe. The MPE
High-Energy group, led by Prof. K. Nandra, carries out major space
hardware programs including the development of X-ray detectors and
X-ray optics in support of its astrophysics research program. Within
the framework of ESA’s future large-class space mission New Athena,
MPE leads the international consortium developing the Wide Field
Imager (WFI), one of the two instruments aboard the X-ray satellite.
Further details about the WFI, which is based on the Max Planck
Society’s unique Silicon DEPFET technology, can be found here:
https://www.mpe.mpg.de/ATHENA-WFI/ The MPE High Energy group is
seeking an experienced Lead System Engineer for the WFI project, who
should in addition have in their earlier career stages been an
accomplished design engineer in any of the primary engineering
disciplines (electronics, optical, mechanical, control and/or software
engineering). As electronics forms the technical core of the
instrument, a design background in electronics engineering is
considered a particular asset. As the Lead System Engineer for the New
Athena WFI, you will be part of the Project Management Team. Working
as a senior member of the WFI team, reporting to the Principal
Investigator and the Project Manager, you will have ample
opportunities to innovate and develop new technical solutions. Lead
System Engineer (m/f/d) for the NEW ATHENA-WFI satellite project Job
Code: 18/2026 Your Tasks: Act as the technical authority for the whole
WFI instrument, establishing, maintaining and controlling the
instrument-level technical baseline throughout the project lifecycle.
Be responsible for the project's technical configuration management.
Work in close and continuous collaboration with the Project Manager,
Project Scientist and the engineering team. Requirements engineering.
Definition and control of technical interfaces (external:
WFI-to-spacecraft; internal: between WFI sub-systems), ensuring
consistency across all responsible sub-system teams. Application of
end-to-end systems analysis and modelling and the subsequent
allocation and management of technical budgets/​tolerances.
Definition of the verification requirements and success criteria that
integration and test plans must satisfy, in coordination with the MAIT
Manager. Support of system integration, verification and testing,
acting as the primary technical interface towards ESA and consortium
partners. Technical Management and Risk Assessment. Prepare technical
documentation for milestones and reviews, assist the Project Manager
with schedule development and resource planning, and monitor
engineering progress against the project schedule, coordinating the
technical actions needed to support timely achievement of engineering
milestones. Your Qualifications: Essential: A completed scientific
university degree (M.Sc. or Dipl.‑Ing.) in engineering or an
equivalent qualification with in‑depth knowledge of scientific
instrumentation development. A physics degree with applicable work
experience in instrumentation development will also be considered.
Desirable: Given that electronics is the technical core of the
instrument, prior design experience in electronics engineering is
regarded as a particular asset, though applicants with a strong
background in the other primary engineering disciplines are equally
encouraged to apply. A higher degree (Ph.D.) in System Engineering
would be an advantage. Knowledge and Experience: Successful candidate
is expected to bring proven systems engineering experience with
designing astronomical or other complex systems. Knowledge of:
Engineering management with a broad knowledge of the technologies
involved in the engineering activities being managed. Principles and
methods of systems engineering and requirements analysis. Technical
risk assessment. Modelling languages, and relevant software tools.
Characterisation methods to evaluate candidate design alternatives.
System integration, tools, test equipment, principles and methods of
validation. Knowledge of ESA design and quality requirements (ECSS
standards) is an advantage. Electronics design principles
(analogue/​digital, front-end and detector electronics) are
considered particularly relevant, given the central role of
electronics in the instrument. Skills: Very good communication skills.
Planning, organising resources, motivating people, measuring
performance and applying corrections where necessary. The ability to
balance technical, schedule, resource and contractual considerations,
and a clear understanding of when a technical decision needs to be
escalated — to the Project Manager or, in more significant cases, to
the Project Office. Fluency in written and spoken English. Fluency in
written and spoken German will be an advantage but is not essential.
We offer: A versatile, challenging and autonomous job in a dynamic and
culturally stimulating international research environment in the
development of satellite instrumentation. Interdisciplinary work in a
team of experienced engineers and physicists. Needs-oriented training

A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join our global team as a highly skilled Electrical Designer for Power Transformers (f/m/d), acting as a central hub of expertise and support for Power Transformer and Shunt Reactors engineers in our factories worldwide. Your role is crucial for ensuring our design processes are efficient, reliable, and continuously evolving. You will focus on providing support in applying solutions and guiding engineers, working closely with factories in Brazil, Mexico, and the USA to implement new tools, design rules, and innovative solutions. By connecting factory needs with our R&D development team, you will help shape the next generation of design technology and foster a culture of continuous learning.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Provide quick technical support to product engineers and assist transformer engineers with R&D rules and tools to minimize downtime
* Conduct pre-release tests of tools in real-world scenarios and provide feedback to developers
* Improve information flow and facilitate communication between factories, R&D, and other stakeholders, ensuring alignment with factory needs
* Ensure consistent global quality through structured technology transfer and work on a centralized knowledge hub for engineers
* Cultivate a community for experts to share knowledge and develop training programs for widespread adoption of best practices
* Propose improvements for tools and rules based on factory experiences, linking R&D advancements with practical engineering applications

What You Bring

* A completed degree in Electrical Engineering
* Longterm experience in Large Power Transformers and Shunt Reactors Design
* Strong understanding of various transformer and reactor types, including electrical design and calculations for dielectric, electro-magnetic, heating, cooling, and noise
* Good understanding of transformer components and their interactions, such as the core, windings, insulation, and leads
* A solid understanding of engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and quality processes, along with experience in technical product development
* Proficiency in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.
