The Flight Dynamics team in Manching develops in-house advanced software tools aimed at large data analysis and post processing. In this context, verification and validation of these tools is required to ensure compliance to the specific tools process.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Checking the scope and code of the tool and the already existing tests as a baseline for discussion and required depth of test coverage.
- Checking the requirements defined as Jira tickets of the tool and discuss potential unclear formulations as well as the scope of testing.
- Choosing requirements to test within a one-week time horizon.
- Implementing test cases within the defined scope (i.e., automatized, repeated, checking edge conditions, checking correct and incorrect user handling,...).
- Incorporating the test cases in the continuous integration pipeline, executing it, and checking the results.
- Documenting the outcome of the tests (i.e., results, limitation, bugs, potential improvements) within the tool’s documentation and reviewing the implemented test cases, discussion of improvements, and providing deliverables on a weekly basis.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full time student (d/f/m) within computer science, data science, informatics or related disciplines.
- Extensive experience in at least one of the following programming languages:
- Java 1.8 and JUnit4 or JUnit5
- Matlab R2024b and testsuite
- Python 3.12 and pytest
- Extensive experience in continuous integration pipeline setup in Jenkins.
- Extensive experience in working with git, specifically Bitbucket as well as knowledge in working with Atlassian toolset, like Confluence and Jira.
- Knowledge of SLURM workload manager
- Knowledge of Linux, Microsoft Word and Latex to report results.
- Understanding of Flight Dynamics (e.g., nonlinear simulation) is a plus.
- Understanding of database structures (e.g., sqlite) and large data storages (e.g., HDF5 or parquet) is a plus.
- Self-organized, team-oriented way of working.
- Advanced English, German is a plus.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Technology Scouting & Innovation Manager (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve systematically identifying emerging technologies, monitoring market disruptions, and analyzing startup activities. You will serve as the organization’s “early warning and opportunity detection system,” translating external technology signals into actionable insights that inform strategy, portfolio steering, and investment decisions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and maintain a structured technology scouting process across H1–H4 horizons
* Identify emerging technologies with potential impact on Grid Technologies
* Own and continuously update the PRM Technology Radar and create strategic heatmaps of technology opportunities and threats
* Maintain visibility of startup, university, and research ecosystems to support partnership and investment opportunities
* Establish and maintain a central technology knowledge repository to ensure effective dissemination of insights
* Produce actionable intelligence reports for leadership teams and convert technology signals into portfolio recommendations

What You Bring

* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma
* Long-term experience in technology development and Ventures/M&A type projects
* Strong technical focus with a solid understanding of what Siemens Energy does, though not necessarily an expert in specific technologies
* Experience in innovation projects involving universities, research facilities, or similar environments
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills in global matrix organizations, with the ability to translate external signals into clear portfolio and roadmap insights
* Fluent in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: System Safety Engineer (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

System Safety Engineer (d/f/m)

to support the Aircraft Development Safety Manching team. You will ensure that Airbus products are developed, designed, produced and supported according to the state-of-art and the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations). Safety of the vehicle is maintained throughout its whole lifecycle, considering Human Factors and operation.

You are interested in assessing complex functions through Aircrafts and Systems, analyse the propagation of mechanical or electrical/electronical malfunctions and unintended human operation throughout the system with regards to hazardous Aircraft reaction.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead and conduct main Safety assessments (Functional Hazard Assessment/System Safety Assessment) activities for military aircraft and systems, supporting the phases until certification
- Lead and conduct Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to support the continuous aircraft development (including Permit to Fly/Type Certificate)
- Lead and conduct Common-Cause Analyses (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis)
- Lead, manage and generate safety requirements, safety evidences (tests, simulation, analyses), Safety Procedures and Limitations, interface with other technical domains (processes, maintenance, human factors, aircraft performance and quality, etc.)
- Strong influence on aircraft/systems architecture development according to the required Safety/Integrity
- Act as interface at the required level with internal and external stake holders (Chief Engineering, Project Management, Design Teams, Airworthiness Authorities, Industrial Partners, Customers, Suppliers)
- Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability

Desired skills and qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree of Aerospace Engineering, Physical Science or similar discipline
- Minimum 3 years working experience in related engineering field
- Knowledge/understanding of Aircraft systems
- System Safety Assessment experience would be an advantage, at least System Engineering experience with interface to Safety Assessment/Airworthiness/Certification
- advanced skills with MS Office are presumed
- Good communication skills and strong problem-solving capability are desirable
- Experience with Safety Tools (e.g. Isograph FaultTree+, Reliability Workbench)
- Very good English language skills, German language is desirable

This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student for the Hector-Center, Medical Clinic 1, (m/f/d) (Assistent/in - klinische Studien)
jobs.description:
The Hector-Center for Nutrition, Exercise and Sports, Medical Clinic 1, conducts clinical and experimental research in the fields of cancer, obesity, food intolerances, and microbiota. Our translational research projects aim to better understand disease mechanisms and ultimately improve patient care and therapeutic strategies.
A major focus of our research is cancer cachexia, a complex metabolic syndrome that significantly contributes to loss of skeletal muscle and adipose tissue, impaired physical function, reduced quality of life, and poor clinical outcomes in patients with cancer.
Within this research area, we investigate the interactions between cancer cells, skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, and immune cells, with a particular focus on the molecular and immunological mechanisms underlying cancer-associated tissue wasting.

Die Aufgaben

To strengthen our research team, we are looking for an excellent and highly motivated PhD student with a strong interest in cancer biology, metabolism, immunology, and/or molecular medicine.
Depending on the specific research focus, the work will involve:

- in vitro studies with cancer and muscle cells as well as immune cell models and analysis of tissue samples
- contribution to in vivo studies with mice
- preparation of scientific manuscripts and the PhD thesis

Das Know-how dafür

- Master’s degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Medicine, Biotechnology, or a related field
- solid knowledge of cellular and molecular biology
- practical experience with cell culture and molecular biology techniques
- ability to work independently, systematically, and reliably
- strong scientific curiosity and willingness to develop new experimental approaches
- ability to analyze and critically interpret scientific data
- excellent communication and teamwork skills
- good written and spoken English

Zusätzlich von Vorteil

- experience with cancer, skeletal muscle, adipocyte, or immune cell models
- experience with molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, or flow cytometry
- FELASA B certificate is advantageous but not mandatory

We are looking for a motivated scientist who is enthusiastic about understanding the mechanisms of cancer-associated wasting and developing new approaches to preserve tissue function and improve outcomes in patients with cancer.

Das bieten wir:

- salary according to E13 TV-L, 65%
- the position is intended to lead to a PhD
- an interdisciplinary and collaborative research environment
- access to modern laboratory infrastructure and established experimental models
- opportunities for scientific training, conference participation, and publication
- close supervision and support throughout the PhD project

Hector-Center for Nutrition, Excercise and Sports

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. The Academic Partnerships organization at SAP partners with other SAP teams to provide the best services to foster strategic research collaborations between SAP and academia. The PhD Graduate Team is responsible for building the bridge between cutting-edge research and SAP functional teams. Our mission is to facilitate the application of research across SAP and contribute to SAP research strategy with interdisciplinary research activities.

Working together with the SAP Autonomous Suite CX team, focusing on customer satisfaction by increasing the predictability of the semester plans, you will bring perspectives and insights from large-scale agile and software development research to our product delivery planning, enhancing SAP’s strategic position in the Autonomous Suite and the innovation speed, and bridging the gap between industry and academia.

- Review metrics health at team, product, and portfolio level to surface bottlenecks and delivery risks early
- Embed retrospective learnings into process standards, creating a continuous improvement loop across Commerce teams
- Pilot AI-assisted tooling to improve planning accuracy, effort estimation, and workflow automation
- Share engineering excellence practices across squads and teams to accelerate adoption of predictable delivery patterns
- Bridge the gap between academic findings and industry

- Be an active part of research mentoring programs and the research community at SAP
- Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders

- Research background (publications preferred) in the field of innovation (incl. AI adoption) in software development models, scrum, agile, adoption or other development models
- Proven track record of applied industry-academic research related to agile contexts (conferences like IEEE CBI, publications preferred)
- Experience leading research projects and delivering data-driven recommendations in collaboration with industry partners
- Hands-on technical skills including data analysis, LLM and AI-assisted prototyping, and working with engineering telemetry data (e.g. Jira) to generate delivery insights, programming skills preferred (python, Java, JavaScript)
- Demonstrated ability to manage industry-academic partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives, and co-organizing large-scale events
- Ability to work on challenging research topics with a structured, scientific approach
- Sound understanding of SAP’s product strategy and the Autonomous Enterprise
- Experience integrating AI assistants in workflows, incl. quality assurance.
- Strong hands-on mindset and willingness to translate promising research direction into product functionality
- Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented mindset
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus

We build collaborative, structured partnerships with academic institutions and encompass a wide range of activities and programs in regards of academic teaching, academic community management, and PhD talent management.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.

This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.

This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.

The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.

**Job Responsibilities:** 

- Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market
- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP
- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients
- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects

Qualifications

- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)
- DC Experience in accountable DM position
- Proficient in contractual German and English
- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines
- Excellent communication skills are essential

Additional Information

Why join us?
You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.

If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.

The role can be home-based, office-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid, and is offered as a permanent full time (1 FTE) or part-time position (0.8 FTE / 80%).

The CRA:

- Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.
- Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..
- Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability.
- Ensures audit readiness.
- Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites.
- Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.
- Travel up to 50-75%

A day in the Life:

- Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
- Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
- Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
- Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
- Brings up observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
- May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
- Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
- Participates in the investigator payment process.
- Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.
- Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable
- Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
- Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).
- Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
- Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.
- Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
- Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
- Gives to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
- Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
- Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
- Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
- Gives to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
- Previous experience in a clinical environment with exposure to clinical research, healthcare or clinical trials that provides the knowledge and skills required to perform the role
- Valid driver's license
- Full Right to work in Germany
- Fluency in English and German language to at least C1 level (note that the interview will be held in German).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Effective clinical monitoring skills
- Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
- Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical attitude, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and decision-making
- Ability to handles Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
- Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
- Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
- Effective social skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Effective organizational and time management skills
- Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
- Ability to work in a team or independently as required
- Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
- Good presentation skills

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As Facilities Manager Europe (f/m/d), you will support Clario's facilities across Europe with a focus on our office in Estenfeld, Germany.

Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work after the probation period.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Facilities Operations: Providing overall facilities support by ensuring the seamless delivery of facility operations, building management, structural measures, maintenance teams, housekeeping, reception, cafeteria operations, asset management, visitor management, and security & safety protocols. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.

*
Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.

*
Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.

*
Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.

*
Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.

*
Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.

*
External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.

*
Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.

*
Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.

*
Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.

*
Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.

*
Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.

*
Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.

*
Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.

*
Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.

*
Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.

*
Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.

*
Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.

*
Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.

Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.

*
Ability to influence others without direct authority.

*
Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.

*
A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.

Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

Together with selected university partner sites, the German Cancer Research Center has established the German Cancer Consortium (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) (Deutsches Konsortium für Translationale Krebsforschung, DKTK). The alliance between the DKFZ, as the core center, and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen joins forces at eight joint translation centers. The DKTK promotes interdisciplinary preclinical translational research topics to accelerate the transfer of results into new approaches for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer and to develop strategies for personalized oncology. The consortium supports the training of the next generation of medical and clinician scientists, operates state-of-the-art, highly specialized research infrastructures and technical platforms, and promotes the transfer of innovations to the economy and society.

For the Research Group "Adaptive Glycan Remodeling in Cancer Progression" (https://amulyasreekumar.owlstown.net/)  (headed by Amulya Sreekumar) at the DKTK partner site Berlin, the DKFZ is seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student in Cancer Biology.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to investigate the mechanisms driving breast cancer progression. Approximately 30% of breast cancer patients who are disease-free after initial therapy ultimately develop local or metastatic recurrences seeded by therapy-evasive residual tumor cells. Such cells often exist in a dormant state and subsequently exit dormancy, thus giving rise to recurrences. We are interested in the molecular mechanisms that promote residual tumor cell persistence after therapy and their subsequent reactivation.
Building on our recent discovery that tumor cell-autonomous glycan biosynthesis supports dormant cell persistence, this project aims to identify therapeutic strategies that disrupt glycan-mediated signaling to eliminate residual tumor cells and prevent lethal recurrence. The work will integrate mechanistic molecular biology, functional genomics, and advanced cancer models to achieve this goal.

The successful candidate will join the DKFZ International PhD Program (https://www.dkfz.de/en/career/international-phd-program) and work in a collaborative environment spanning DKFZ and Charité/DKTK Berlin. This partnership provides access to cutting-edge core facilities, including high-content imaging, flow cytometry, and genomics technologies at both institutions.
Our laboratory is located within the Department of Hematology, Oncology, and Cancer Immunology at Charité-Campus Virchow Klinikum in Berlin.

Your Tasks

- Performing molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry experiments using human and murine breast cancer models 
- Working with genetically engineered mouse models and transplantable tumors
- Gaining problem-solving and analytical skills through active participation and training
- Integration and interpretation of data 
- Presenting research findings at national/international conferences
- Contributing to high-impact scientific publications

Your Profile

- Master's degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline 
- Strong interest in cancer research and the molecular mechanisms underlying disease progression
- Practical experience in molecular biology
- Mammalian cell culture experience and an interest in working with mouse models are desirable 
- Collaborative, highly motivated working style with good attention to detail

What makes this Position special:

- A fully funded PhD position within the DKFZ International PhD Program

NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.

Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the our revolutionary Glassomer technology, silica nanocomposites which can be processed like a polymer and subsequently converted to pure fused silica, with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
You will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.

In order to support our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team**,** Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

** Eurodrone Overall RPAS Design Chief Engineer (d/f/m)**

Are you passionate about shaping the future of Airbus Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) products? Join our Overall Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) Design Team for Eurodrone and contribute your skills and enthusiasm to our dynamic Chief Engineering Organization. As such, execute overall design and steering activities to ensure a consistent RPAS design and integration across all functions and through the entire lifecycle, compliant with top level system requirements. Steer the flight chain (Ground Safety Critical Control Station, Flight Management System, Safe Flight and Landing System) as an integral part of the overall RPAS design and ensure the compliance with all overall RPAS design activities.

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

- Optimize design for the overall RPAS and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.
- Perform trades & candidate aircraft configurations associated to RPA and flight chain architectures & requirements.
- Coordinate the flight chain design (GSCCS, FMCS, FMAIS, SFLS), ensuring consistent safety-critical design.
- Ensure RPA compliance with airworthiness and safety, environmental conditions, design maturity, security and RPAS airport operations at the aircraft level.
- Control the RPA and flight chain technical baseline and design changes, Assessing the consequences of technical Change Requests on overall RPAS architecture and aircraft configuration, ensuring configuration maturity aligns with programme milestones and safety objectives.
- Lead the definition of the certification and qualification roadmap for in close alignment with customer and regulatory bodies.
- Integrate and coordinate Flight Physics activities (performance, HQ, loads) and drive flight chain consistent solutions into the overall configuration.
- Achieving the handling quality requirements for the RPAS failure free and for failure cases.
- Secure the project schedule to achieve the program milestones, align technical directives to all design teams, ensuring end to end readiness.
- Ensure integration and verification plans and activities to achieve final certification and qualification; from analysis and simulation through systems testing and completed at Flight Test Level.

If you are ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a significant impact on the future of Airbus UAV products, we encourage you to apply.

- Master of Science in Aerospace Engineering or equivalent.
- Significant Engineering experience > 8 years in related area.
- You have excellent leadership skills and profound experience in leading teams.
- Deep knowledge of Flight Dynamics, Flight Mechanics and Flight Control Laws.
- Extensive experience in the development of Flight Control Systems.
- Experience in the development of DAL-A software.
- Knowledge in Overall Aircraft Design, Overall System Design and Overall Physical Design.
- Operational knowledge on UAS or aircraft Operation, in particular Automatic Take Off and Landing.
- Proven track record in project management and technical management.
- Excellent coordination and communication skills.
- Goal-oriented mind set and good analytical skills.
- Very strong team player.
- Exceptional English language skills (Negotiation Level).

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Department Pediatric Neurooncology is looking, starting from 01.11.2026, for a Strategic Officer.

The department led by Prof. Stefan Pfister at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) and the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center Heidelberg (KiTZ) combines international pediatric oncology research with data-driven precision oncology and the development of sustainable research infrastructures.

A key international initiative of the department is the ITCC PedCanPortal, a data and research platform developed in collaboration with leading European partners in pediatric oncology. The project aims to bring together a large, international multi-omics dataset comprising molecular and clinical data from more than 5,000 patients and to make these high-quality research data, along with analytical tools, accessible and sustainably available to the international research community. In doing so, the ITCC PedCanPortal aims to support the development of new diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for children and adolescents with cancer.

The Strategic Officer will work at the interface of science, strategy, international partnerships, and the sustainable development of the ITCC PedCanPortal, with a particular focus on establishing the organizational and financial structures required for its long-term sustainability.

Your Tasks

Your primary responsibility will be to develop, coordinate, and implement a comprehensive long-term continuity and implementation strategy for ITCC PedCanPortal beyond its current funding period (e.g., via a non-profit spin-off). Sustainability planning will be treated as a continuous and evolving process, closely aligned with the scientific, technical, ethical, and operational development of the platform.

Microstructured optical fibers are key components for next-generation photonic technologies including quantum communication, high-speed data transmission, and advanced sensing. However, current manufacturing methods such as stack-and-draw strongly limit the achievable fiber geometries and prevent the realization of many theoretically predicted high-performance fiber designs.
Within this PhD project, novel silica nanocomposite materials and manufacturing technologies will be developed to overcome these limitations. The project combines the Glassomer technology with high-resolution additive manufacturing and scalable extrusion processes to directly fabricate complex microstructured glass fiber preforms. The developed materials will be converted into high-purity fused silica glass and further processed into optical fibers in collaboration with project partners.
A particular focus will be placed on the development of photocurable and thermoplastic silica nanocomposites, optimization of their processing behavior, and tailoring of the glass composition to improve thermal stability during fiber fabrication. The project aims to establish a new manufacturing platform for optical fibers with unprecedented design freedom.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of materials science, glass science, polymer chemistry, additive manufacturing, and photonics. The project offers the opportunity to contribute to next-generation optical fiber technologies with applications ranging from quantum technologies to future communication systems.
Developing novel photocurable silica nanocomposites for high-resolution additive manufacturing of microstructured glass preforms.
Formulating highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass processing.
Investigating particle dispersion, rheological properties, curing behavior, and processing windows of nanocomposite systems.
Processing nanocomposites using advanced manufacturing technologies, including: Stereolithography-based 3D printing, Extrusion-based shaping
Developing strategies for modifying glass compositions (e.g., dopant integration) to tailor processing and material properties.
Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.
Collaborating with project partners on the fabrication of next-generation microstructured optical fibers.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

jobs.description:
Postdoc (m/f/d) – Translational Cancer Research | Gastroenterology 

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

The Department of Internal Medicine II at TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our newly established Max Eder Research Group.

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples. 

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

- Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
- Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
- Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
- Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
- Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
- Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
- Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals

Your profile:

We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

- PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
- Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
- Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
- Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
- Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
- Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
- Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
- Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

We offer you:

- A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
- An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers
- Close collaboration with internationally renowned research groups at the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), Sutton, UK, and Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden, including opportunities for scientific exchange and short-term research stays at both partner institutions.
- Direct integration with prospective clinical trials and longitudinal patient cohorts
- Close collaboration with physicians, computational biologists and internationally recognized research partners
- Strong mentorship and excellent opportunities for scientific independence and career development
- Support for national and international conference attendance
- Competitive salary according to TV-L
- EGYM Wellpass, corporate benefits, company pension scheme (VBL), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with excellent public transport connections

We look forward to your application!
