Job description

AGGP2027 – Graduate Eurodrone Overall RPAS Design Chief Engineering Office

Start date: October 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs.  Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

What you will be doing

You will be on a development journey to guide your growth into the role of Overall RPAS Design Chief Engineering Office for Eurodrone and can expect to be involved in the following:

1. Optimize design for the overall Eurodrone and ensure integration of all level 1 sub-products.

2. Support the Eurodrone configuration and loft design to ensure right specification and selection of systems (e.g. LG, engine, IPS, etc.).

3. Steer the system and equipment interfaces and drive the equipment qualification

4. Coordinate the flight chain design including the safe flight and landing system, ensuring consistent safety-critical design.

5. Ensure Eurodrone compliance with airworthiness and safety, environmental conditions, design maturity, security and RPAS airport operations at the aircraft level.

6. Integrate and coordinate Environmental, EME & Tempest, Electrical, RAMT, Predictive Maintenance, Thermal and Electrical Loads at the RPA level.

7. Ensure integration and verification plans and activities to achieve final certification and qualification; from analysis and simulation through systems testing and completed at Flight Test Level

8. Representing the Eurodrone Program Systems community in coordination with Chief Engineering team in front of internal and external parties

Your development journey will include a minimum of one rotational placement to support your growth into position.

At the end of the two year development programme, you will have developed into the position of Chief Engineering!

** What we are looking for**

To be a successful applicant, you will need to demonstrate you have:

- A degree level or equivalent within aerospace engineering with focus on systems engineering

- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of systems engineering, system design, flight physics

- Knowledge in Overall Aircraft Design, Overall System Design and Overall Physical Design

- Knowledge of Flight Dynamics, Flight Mechanics and Flight Control Laws

- Strong verbal and written communication in our business language (English)

- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation

- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your development.

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. Take the time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected.

STATEMENT: This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

** What is the recruitment process…**

Online application -> Online Task Based Assessment -> Application Review (Talent Acquisition Partner & Manager) -> Virtual Assessment Centre -> Offer!

NB: Applications will close 30 September 2026 (don’t delay, apply early as some roles may close before this date due to applications received). All applications and CVs need to be in English.

Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments. Examples of this may include (but is not exclusive to) accessible facilities and additional time for written exercises etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

CF A Internal Control (IC) is
the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens.
We create impact through the definition and continuous improvement of a
state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global
internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with
corporate governance owners, we maintain a central repository of globally
harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well
as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the
internal control process.
As Siemens transforms
into ONE Tech Company, our IC department plays a critical role in
ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over
Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the
forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including Generative AI – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support
Siemens' strategic growth levers.
We are looking for a
dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires
others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in
Munich or Erlangen.
Accelerate your career and change the world of tomorrow with us.
What You'll Do:

- Drive Innovation with Generative AI (GenAI): Ideate, design, and
implement innovative use cases leveraging GenAI to
transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and
risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You
will be a key driver in exploring how GenAI can enhance control
effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.

effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially
for IT controls of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g.,
ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.

for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology
and update the RIC Manual to reflect new methodological
developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.

professionals throughout the world on all aspects of the internal control
system and become the primary contact for IT Controls methodology and
emerging topics like platform- and GenAI-driven controls.

Internal Control trainings, guidance materials, and presentations to

of continuous learning and excellence.
- Collaborate with the External Auditor: Align and discuss
Internal Control topics and methodology with the external auditor to

- Keep Management informed: Understand global
patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control
deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where
applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s
view.
- Contribute Beyond IC: Engage with the
broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through
assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the 'CF A innovation process', or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Your Profile for "Making the Future Possible":

- Strong Academic Foundation: Degree in business
administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally
a master’s degree.
- Proven IC & IT Controls Expertise: Extensive professional experience in Internal Control (including ICFR) with
a focus on IT controls. You understand the role IT systems
like SAP ERP play in an ICFR control landscape and how systems enable IT
Application Controls (ITACs) and are protected by IT General Controls
(ITGCs).
- Passion for Innovation & GenAI: Strong interest and
ideally hands-on experience in Generative AI and its
application to business processes. You are excited to explore, ideate, and

in internal controls and risk management.

topics like RPA, low-code apps, AI/ML, and their potential

- Growth Mindset: You enjoy taking on
new challenges and growing with them. You thrive in ambiguity and are
comfortable pioneering new approaches.
- International & Intercultural Experience: Work experience in
an international business setting and intercultural collaboration is a
strong plus, reflecting Siemens' global footprint and diverse teams.
- Adaptability & Results Orientation: You impress with
your ability to adapt to a fast-growing, dynamic environment, your focus
on results, teamwork, and customer orientation.
- Excellent Communication Skills: Strong
communication skills in German and English (written and
spoken) to engage effectively with global stakeholders.
- Digital Proficiency: Very good MS Office skills and comfort working with digital tools and
platforms. Willingness and ability to quickly learn and adopt new
technologies is essential.

Why Join Us?

- Contribute to strategic initiatives around GenAI, digital business, and innovation in the context of internal controls.
- Work at the intersection of governance, technology, and innovation, shaping the future of internal controls in
a global technology leader.
- Access to continuous learning and development opportunities, including exposure to cutting-edge

Ready to pioneer the future of Internal Controls? Apply now and make an impact with us!

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for Auxiliary Systems (Fluid Systems) of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global Supply Chain network. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Mechanical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes turbine air inlet, exhaust duct, expansion joint, enclosures, exhaust stack, heat exchangers, and other large, welded steel fabrications.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and product inspections for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification. Inspection types include visual, dimensional, weld, coating, pressure, traceability, quality records.
* Supplier Qualification and Development: Perform routine audits according to supplier risk categorization and audit program. Support supplier evaluation and commodity strategy definition. Implement supplier quality improvement programs or risk mitigation measures.
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary.
* Digitalization & Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality & Development tools and databases. E.g. to create process transparency or periodically generate supplier quality performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above.
* Knowledge and experience in auditing. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Knowledge in the application of quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, RCA.
* Familiarity with the following technologies & standards (or equivalents) are an advantage:
- Design of steel fabrications (AISC 360, EN 1090‑2, ASME VIII, B31.1, PED, API 661)
- Welding (AISC 360, AWS D1.1/ D1.2/ D1.6, ASME IX, ISO 3834, ISO 15614, ISO 5817, ISO 9606)
- Coating & surface preparation (SSPC, ISO 12944, ISO 8501, ISO 8502)
- Inspection methods (Visual Inspection, Penetrant Testing, Magnetic Particle, Ultrasonic Testing, Radiographic Testing)
- Material cleaning & preservation (ASTM A380M)
- Certifications in respective technology fields (NDT Level II or III, AMPP/ NACE CIP, FROSIO, AWS CWI/ SCWI, CSWIP 3.1/ 3.2, IWE, AWS CWEng)
* Willingness to travel as required for the role (approximately 35%) as well as strong communication skills in English.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

In order to support the Chief Engineering Eurodrone team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Eurodrone Overall RPAS Technical Manager (d/f/m)

Eurodrone Programme – Shaping the future of UAS

With its groundbreaking industrial and commercial setup and its unique certification and flexibility, European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) showcases how European industry can find innovative ways to support strategic autonomy needs and prepare for the Future Combat Air System. European MALE RPAS is not just the first programme to fully implement digital design manufacturing and services (DDMS). It is also seen as a ‘light-house’ programme, not only within Airbus, but also for the entire aeronautics industry in Europe.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Technically lead and direct the overall planning and implementation to ensure the readiness and conduction of Eurodrone Phase 1C activities across all contributing organizations - including top level planning of all maintenance and RPAS updates from an overall perspective:

- Secure Flight Test Readiness of the involved test centres in Germany, Italy and Spain (e.g., training, logistics, airworthiness, operations, resources, processes).
- Provide leadership, guidance and direction on any aspects related to the maintenance, preparation and future support of the Eurodrone test fleet, associated activities (including potential FTI updates).
- Lead the installation/maintenance of a strategic fleet program.
- Support program teams to produce all technical documentations for future options.
- Act as technical customer interface for GFx management and loan requests for the use of GFx assets.
- Priories and steers equipment, GSTE and FTI spares distribution across Test Centres (Benches and RPAS prototypes), including repair management and availability of export licenses in coordination with equipment management, procurement and logistic teams.
- Execute overall management of extant or potential Cross-Program conflicts
- As the Eurodrone Engineering focal point, provide and take full responsibility for Major Asset Activity Reporting (RPAS, Benches and Equipment/Spares for BT, GT, FT, DTIS and IDTTs), supporting the program and customer reporting process (status and issues).
- Lead lessons Learned, conflict resolution, and any other matter related to whole P1C activities, amongst others RPAS bench, ground or flight testing.
- Contribute to Overall RPAS BT, GT and FT tasks allocation, considering all technical & program constraints and project directives, risks, dependencies and opportunities and underwrite the agreed output and act as escalation point of the Flight Test Management Group in case arbitration between test centers needed.
- Ensure consistency between Test Program and Certification/Qualification Plans.
- Lead adaptation of contract, if and when required.
- Coordinates and chairs: BT, GT and FT Functional Reviews (e.g., IRR, TRR, VR, FFR, Co-TRR), integrated within the Eurodrone meetings cycle, providing Program and Customer Representatives full visibility of the status of each test program
- Provide guidance, advice, recommendations or other appropriate responses to Eurodrone Chief Engineer and Program senior management on:
- the status of the BT, GT and FT program
- the status of the Eurodrone test fleet
- issues relevant to maintaining the availability of the test fleet to support present and future Eurodrone contracts.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Minimum of 8 - 10 years of experience in Flight Test Management of multinational programs, preferably in the multinational Test Center environment.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience aerospace test and verification, with a strong focus on RPAS/UAS or complex aircraft systems.
- Proven experience in leading and managing technical teams in a demanding aerospace environment.
- In-depth knowledge of flight test methodologies, data acquisition systems, and flight test instrumentation.
- Strong understanding of aerospace safety regulations, airworthiness requirements, and certification processes (e.g., EASA, MIL-STD) with national airworthiness authorities.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders.
- Proficiency in German and fluency in English is required
- Spanish or Italian is a plus.
- Ability to travel as required for test campaigns and meetings.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Global Head of Procurement & Logistics (f/m/d) for Digital Grid (DG), you will lead the global procurement and logistics organization and shape the function as a strategic business partner, value creator, and digital innovator. You will define and execute DG's global procurement and logistics strategy, strengthen supply chain resilience, drive operational excellence, and accelerate the adoption of AI, data, and digital technologies across the end-to-end value chain.

You will partner closely with business leaders, engineering, operations, finance, logistics, and digitalization teams to build a future-ready operating model that improves competitiveness, delivery reliability, compliance, and sustainable business performance.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute a global procurement and logistics strategy that aligns with business objectives, ensuring growth, profitability, and delivery commitments.
* Build and manage a high-performing global supplier ecosystem, driving supplier development and risk mitigation strategies to enhance material availability and business continuity.
* Champion the transformation of procurement and logistics into a data-driven function by identifying and scaling AI use cases to enhance decision-making and business performance.
* Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, productivity improvements, and logistics efficiency, while fostering a culture of ownership, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team, focusing on building high-performing cross-functional teams and strengthening future capabilities through talent development and inclusive leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, connecting business strategy with procurement and logistics execution to drive overall organizational success.

What You Bring

* A degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Economics, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
* Many years of experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, or strategic sourcing within a global industrial or technology-driven organization.
* Several years of success in leading global and cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders across various regions and functions.
* Experience leading or contributing to analytics, automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives in procurement, supply chain, logistics, operations, or a comparable environment.
* Strong commercial, financial, contractual, supplier management, negotiation, and risk-management expertise.
* Proficient communication in English with the ability to translate business needs into practical priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

As part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.
To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world.
Our Cybersecurity team provides core assurance over the cybersecurity health of the company which includes IT infrastructures, product security, software development and cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of them?
To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf) .
What part will you play?

- As valuable member of the assurance team you will be responsible for conducting Cybersecurity assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems, and software development centers. During this process you will perform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions. - Apply hacking principles and red team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.- You independently conduct research on latest developments in cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree) in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as GIAC GPEN, OSCP, CRTP, eJPT, CREST, etc. are a plus. - Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.- At least 2+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.- You have first experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated first experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team.

While commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch beyond our comfort zone. CF A offers ample opportunities to seek the challenge:
Caring for the world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at CF A for over a decade.
Everyone at CF A has the possibility to actively engage in our global Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motivated CSR projects.

What we offer

- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family (for Germany)- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growth

Why us?
Working at Siemens Digital Industries Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of  , religion, color, national origin, ___ , gender, gender expression,   orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We look forward to your application! Please use only our career platform, which you can access via "Apply now". Send us an email to careers-DACH.sisw@siemens.com, if you would like to clarify initial questions with our recruiting team. Contact person for this job advertisement is Nadia Dzianisawa. Come and learn more about Siemens Software: Mission / Vision and our software portfolio - or visit our homepage.
The salary range for this position is 61,400 EUR to 98,400 EUR and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

jobs.description:
Description

As a DFT engineer, you will lead the complete DFT solution for a chip project, with responsibilities spanning all aspects of semiconductor development.

Responsibilities

- You will create DFT specifications, create verification plans, and define the SoC test interface.
- You will develop and implement the DFT architecture and own its integration into large SoC blocks — including IP integration, system and control bus connectivity, and the integration of memories and hard macros.
- You will implement testbenches, generate directed and constrained-random tests, debug failures, run gate-level simulations, and close coverage.
- You will also generate structural test vectors, run synthesis and timing closure and work closely with Chip Architecture, DV, Physical Design, and Power teams to achieve first-tapeout success.
- Additional responsibilities include supporting STA, physical, power, and logical analysis for DFT modes, partnering with Test Engineers to bring up test vectors on silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- B.Sc./M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Knowledge of Verilog and/or VHDL, and familiarity with simulators and waveform debugging tools.
- Exposure to a scripting language such as Python, TCL, or Perl, including familiarity with leveraging generative AI tools to support scripting and engineering workflows.
- Ability to fluently speak and write in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to industry-standard DFT concepts such as ATPG, JTAG, or MBIST.
- Knowledge of general logic design principles.
- Exposure to design verification methodologies, coverage analysis, and assertions.
- Good problem-solving and communication skills.
- Experience in large SoC design or verification — a plus.

At Apple, we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

jobs.occupation: Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder. THE WHAT
• Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
• Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
• Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
• Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
• Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE
• 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
• Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
• Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
• Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
• Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
• Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
• Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
• Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
• Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
• Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
• Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
• Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
• Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
• Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Offshore LTP Project Manager in SE GS AP PM C3, you play a key role in delivering Gas Turbine Long-Term Program projects and in building long-term customer success in Korea, Japan, and Australia.

As JetBrains expands its cloud and SaaS offerings, maintaining customer trust and robust security compliance is critical. jobs.description:
Description

You will need a fundamental understanding of HW and SW design, as well as the eagerness to do hands-on verification. The cool thing is, once you crack the design verification world, it will potentiate your knowledge of HW/SW systems in the RF world. We will introduce you to assertion-based verification, simulation acceleration, and formal methods. You will learn special verification languages as universal verification methodology (UVM) or formal description languages, like SVA, flanked by AI-based approaches. Our team is a very strong cellular hardware design verification team with very good individual communication. You will work in a strong team setup with a lot of interpersonal interaction that will help you to get a very wide understanding of our work, as well as the sub-system and system integration into RF modems. You will build metric-driven verification plans from specifications, review them, and refine them to achieve coverage targets. You will define functional verification requirements based on design requirements and architect and develop UVM-based, highly reusable test benches starting from different components over a cluster into SoC levels.

Minimum Qualifications

- Proven experience in taping out SoC systems with embedded processor cores and hands-on verification experience in UVM environments.
- Strong collaborative work experience with system, design, and firmware teams.
- Verification and Validation approach, as well as outstanding sense and commitment to the quality of deliverables
- A detective skill for finding bugs and weaknesses
- Having a good view of the definition and design process of a chip
- Holistically thinking beyond the design verification domain boundaries
- Good interpersonal and communication skills
- English language proficiency is required for this position

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's (or higher degree) in Electrical Engineering or Communication Engineering with several years of working experience.
- System know-how in the cellular RF transceiver domain is a plus
- Proficiency in RISC-V architecture, encompassing design, verification, and programming, is highly valued
- Knowledge of assertion-based verification would be nice to have
- Ideally, you worked on system/IP definition, system/IP validation, system/IP design, system/IP testing, or similar
- Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

Responsibilities

- As a member of the verification team you will develop verification test plans, tools, test benches, protocol monitors, and high-coverage stimulus vectors. You will apply sophisticated techniques to achieve verification with the highest quality, efficiency, and time-to-market You are going to work closely with the design team to ensure timely delivery of quality designs. You will also work with methods to accelerate verification time and will be involved in Post Silicon Validation.

Minimum Qualifications

- You should have a BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- Ability to fluently speak & write in English.

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experiences in SoC verification.
- Knowledge of SoC architecture/design and in-depth knowledge of verification flow.
- Strong understanding and proven experience in the sophisticated verification process, including dynamic, coverage-based and formal methods.
- Experience using some of the following: Perl, e, Verilog, System Verilog, C, C++, TCL.
- Familiarity with verification environments e.g. UVM, System Verilog is an advantage.
- Knowledge in formal, hardware acceleration is a plus.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead and execute clinical Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) modeling projects within multidisciplinary systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and drug development teams, driving model-informed decision making across development programs.
- Additionally, you will develop, qualify, apply, and communicate fit-for-purpose QSP models that integrate non-clinical, translational, biomarker, and clinical data to address critical scientific and development questions.
- You will also translate biological and pharmacological knowledge into quantitative model structures, assumptions, and simulations, generating actionable insights while clearly communicating model limitations, uncertainties, and their potential impact.
- Furthermore, you will define and drive QSP modeling strategies aligned with project objectives, delivering scientifically robust analyses and interpretations to support clinical development decisions.
- You will provide independent advice on complex mechanistic modeling challenges and represent QSP expertise in cross-functional scientific, technical, and strategic discussions.
- Beyond this, you will provide scientific leadership and guidance throughout model development, qualification, application, and communication activities while fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners.
- Finally, you will drive innovation, standardization, and digitalization in mechanistic modeling and simulation by evaluating, developing, and implementing novel methodologies, tools, and technologies, while overseeing external modeling activities to ensure scientific excellence and strategic alignment.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, clinical pharmacology, computational biology, bioengineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- Several years of hands-on professional experience in QSP modeling in the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory authorities, or relevant academic research
- In-depth knowledge of mechanistic modeling in clinical drug development, including model development, calibration, qualification, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and interpretation of results
- Experience with R and/or relevant QSP modeling platforms such as MATLAB/SimBiology, Julia, OSP Suite, or comparable tools; experience with statistical methods for analysis of nonclinical and clinical data is beneficial
- Strong ability to communicate complex modeling concepts, assumptions, uncertainties, and decision impact clearly to multidisciplinary audiences
- Proven collaboration skills in international, multidisciplinary teams and ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including experts, CROs, vendors, and leadership teams
- Fluent in written and spoken English

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 
 
What you’ll do: 

Are you ready to take a senior engineering role in shaping mission-critical planning solutions at the heart of the world’s leading enterprise software company? This is an opportunity to contribute to SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with a focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). Together, these solutions help customers plan complex supply chains, optimize service levels, production resources, material availability, and operational execution across industries. 

You will work on business-critical planning capabilities used by customers with large service parts, manufacturing, warehouse, dealer, and distribution networks. Our roadmap includes modern SAP Fiori user experiences, advanced planning algorithms, forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, analytics, integration with SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as aATP, and the next wave of AI-assisted planning, optimization, and navigation. 

As a Senior Developer in our SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning team, you will: 

- Own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of complex features across eSPP and PP/DS, with responsibility for quality, maintainability, performance, and long-term product standard compliance. 
- Apply your strong C++ background to analyze and evolve planning and optimization-related components, while also working with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, and SAP S/4HANA integration patterns. 
- Contribute to capabilities for service parts planning, production planning, detailed scheduling, forecasting, inventory planning, stocking and destocking decisions, simulation, mass maintenance, analytics, and integration with adjacent SAP solutions. 
- Drive technical concepts, architectural improvements, refactoring, automated tests, code reviews, root-cause analysis, and defect prevention for mission-critical private cloud products. 
- Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, quality engineers, product management, and development colleagues across locations to translate customer and roadmap requirements into reliable, scalable, and user-oriented solutions. 
- Act as a technical role model for less experienced developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs and code, and helping the team continuously improve engineering practices. 
- Help shape the next generation of planning capabilities, including AI-assisted planning experiences, Joule-based contextual assistance, embedded analytics, and modern SAP Fiori user experiences. 
 
What you bring: 
- A good to excellent university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Natural Sciences, or a related field. 
- Several years of professional software development experience, ideally in enterprise software, planning, optimization, logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing-related domains. 
- A strong C++ background is required, including solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable code design. 
- Experience with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, or SAP S/4HANA architecture is a strong plus; willingness to broaden your expertise across the SAP technology stack is expected. 
- Experience or strong interest in PP/DS, eSPP, Production Planning, Materials Management, service parts planning, detailed scheduling, or related supply chain planning processes. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex planning algorithms, business processes, and customer scenarios. 
- A senior mindset: ownership, technical leadership, high quality standards, clear communication, constructive collaboration, and the ability to guide others while remaining hands-on. 
- Fluent communication skills in English; German language skills are beneficial. 

Tech & topics you will work with 

- You will deepen and apply your expertise in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). 
- You will work across C++, ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, SAP S/4HANA integration, analytics, and development practices used in mission-critical private cloud products. 
- You will contribute to planning and optimization capabilities, including forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, advanced analytics, AI-assisted planning, enterprise search, Joule-based assistance, and guided planning experiences. 
 
Meet the team: 

This senior role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership in strategic SAP planning solutions that help customers run complex after-sales, manufacturing, and supply chain planning processes more efficiently, transparently, and intelligently. You will contribute to the evolution of both eSPP and PP/DS while growing as a recognized expert in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning. 
 

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/w/d)

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

As a Systems & Software Architect for the Flight Test Ground Station (FTGS)

- you will lead the end-to-end architectural lifecycle for a complex suite of flight test tools, including FTGS-Core, FIDA, and various Add-On tools.
- you will be responsible for defining and documenting comprehensive system requirements, balancing operational needs, technical constraints, and stringent regulatory requirements.
- your core mission involves developing and iterating robust architectures encompassing hardware, software, and network infrastructure.
- Utilizing established architectural patterns and best practices, you will design modular, scalable systems and produce high-quality design specifications, interface definitions, and technical documentation.

- By leading "tiger teams" to address critical issues and facilitating continuous improvement through rigorous retrospectives, you will ensure long-term technical consistency.
- Furthermore, you will remain at the forefront of the industry by monitoring emerging technologies and trends in flight test and ground station systems, ensuring the FTGS toolchain remains cutting-edge and future-proof.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Education: Completed university degree (Master’s or Diploma) in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
- Professional Experience: Several years of professional experience in system architecture or the design of complex technical systems, ideally within the Aerospace or Defense sectors.
- Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of Flight Test Ground Station systems, telemetry, data processing, and data analysis.
- Technical Proficiency:
- Advanced expertise in C++ development and software design patterns.
- Strong command of Linux environments and system administration.
- Proven experience with various software/hardware architectures and network protocols.
- Expertise in defining system requirements and creating architectural models (e.g., UML, SysML).
- Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions.
- Soft Skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to thrive in a multidisciplinary, international environment.
- Languages: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
- Travel: Willingness to undertake occasional business travel.
- Preferred: Practical experience in flight test analysis is advantageous.

Job description

In order to support our “Technical Certification Team”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Electronics and/or military Avionics Designated Airworthiness Engineer (d/f/m)

This team provides certification expertise across all Airbus Defence and Space aircraft programs and represents Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead the certification, qualification and Continued Airworthiness activities for the Electronics and/or Military Avionics technical disciplines.
- Provide airworthiness approvals and exercise Design Organisations Approvals (DOA) as well as Military Design Organisation Approvals (MDOA) privileges for the scope of assigned responsibility as delegated by the Office of Chief of Airworthiness.
- Be responsible for the timely achievement of certification and qualification milestones through identification of major program technical issues and associated risk management plan, identification of regulation and interpretation issues and identification of safety and certification compliance issues.
- Lead the necessary activities for the investigation of incidents and accidents for those aspects regarding Airworthiness technical knowledge.
- Provide technical certification knowledge in Electronics and/or Military Avionics to the design organization, or special projects.
- Influence the definition of certification policies for the technical discipline under his/her scope, and promote their consistent application across programs, including the participation in the development of new and foreseen technical certification strategies or policies. In particular for novel or unusual design features or for compliance demonstration method improvement.
- Represent Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups for technical certification.
- Contribute to technical certification de-risking in Airbus Defence and Space Research and Technology (R&T) as well as Research and Development (R&D) projects related to the Airworthiness Technical.
- Gather and disseminate Technical Certification regulatory knowledge and expertise within Airbus Defence and Space, particularly for Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) and Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) community, to maintain state of the art.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering.
- Extensive professional experience (more than 10 years) in Airworthiness functions related to Electronics and/or Military Avionics discipline.
- Experience interfacing with Aviation Authorities is a plus.
- Excellent negotiation skills, strong interpersonal and consulting skills.
- Ability to understand complex issues and break them down in order to develop solutions independently.
- Advanced level of English.
- Good knowledge of German language is a plus.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: Head of PS Division Incident Management (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
At TÜV SÜD Group, we are passionate about technology. Innovations shape our lives in many different ways, and at TÜV SÜD Group, we are highly committed to playing an active role in this progress. We test, we certify, we inspect, and we advise. We challenge ourselves every day to help ensure the safety of people and society. We live technology. We strive for professional excellence. We make an impact. We take the future into our own hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

The PS Division Incident Management Department plays a critical role in our business by ensuring that operational disruptions are identified,  managed, and resolved swiftly and effectively, safeguarding service continuity in a highly regulated environment. It is a key differentiator,
demonstrating our ability to meet stringent compliance requirements while maintaining trust with clients and regulators. Beyond reactive response, it enables proactive issue identification and mitigation, strengthening our “license to operate” by reducing risk exposure and
ensuring accountability. Furthermore, robust incident management minimizes the likelihood and impact of service failures, helping protect the organization from financial losses, reputational damage, and potential damage claims.

Leadership Tasks:

- Work with the current Head of PS Incident Management to lead &
develop of a central team to:
o manage serious incidents/ complaints/ claims in regard to PS
business globally
o to protect the TÜV SÜD brand in regard to the use of
certification marks under PS division
o coordinate global quality assurance activities such as
comparison tests for high-risk products as preventive action
to avoid future incidents
- To take over the position of Head of PS Division Incident
Management by Mid-2027 and ensure a proper handover of
leadership

Tasks of the PS Incident Management in relation to risk
management and damage claims:

- Develop and coordinate strategies to defend PS Division against
unjustified damage claims and reduce legitimate claims to the
extent of the fault
- Coordination of the investigation of serious incidents/ complaints/
deviations or claims (processes and technical issues) with
complaint managers located in the operations worldwide according
to the global PS Division Incident Management Procedure
- Risk assessment and risk reporting to the management
- Manage activities and coordination with external legal counsel as
corporate legal department at TÜV SÜD
- Support PS certification bodies and coordination of communication
with accreditation bodies and supervisory authorities (e.g. in case
of hearing letters and withdrawal of licenses proceedings)
- Coordinate with PS Quality Management to provide input on
improvements based on analysis of incidents/ complaints/
deviations or claims
- Support of operational departments in high-risk projects

Tasks of PS Incident Management in relation to risk management
and damage claims:

- Implementation and maintenance of EU border seizure procedures
according to EU Regulation 608/2013 für TÜV SÜD Product
Service trademarks
- Trade fair inspections in cooperation with customs/criminal
investigators and TÜV Markenverbund e.V.
- Provide anti-counterfeiting training in relation to TÜV SÜD and TÜV
SÜD Product Service marks
- Prosecution of trademark infringements and forgery of certificates,
test reports or licenses in cooperation with certification bodies
- Manage cease-and-desist letters to enforce claims regarding
misuse of TÜV SÜD brand/ marks in relation to Product Service
issues

Tasks of the PS Incident Management in relation to Quality
Assurance:

- Identify high risk products within the testing and certification scope
in the field of Product Service which could cause future incidents/
complaints/ deviations or claims
- Coordinate global quality assurance activities such as elected
comparison tests for high-risk products detected by the risk radar
system
- Analyse the results in close cooperation with technical experts and
Quality Management to determine preventive actions.

Qualification:

- Technical or legal degree
- Strong comprehension skills – especially in technical matters
- Solid legal knowledge - especially in contract law, trademark law,
procedural law, and the German Product Safety Act (ProdSG) and
Medical Devices Regulation (MDR)
- Expert-level knowledge in the areas of accreditation and
certification of consumer, commercial and medical devices
- Resilience, perseverance, assertiveness, and a hands-on
approach
- Flexibility and the ability to quickly grasp complex issues
- Risk Awareness
- Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and
German due to communication with accreditors and market
surveillance authorities as well as law enforcement authorities.
Aditional language skills are welcome

At TÜV SÜD Group, people from more than 100 nations work together – people with different backgrounds, skills and goals. Our strength lies in these many diverse perspectives.

jobs.occupation: Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Engineering Change Manager (d//f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Donauwörth
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 24 months

Join us as a working student (d/f/m) in Engineering to actively support our transformation and change towards the Engineering of tomorrow. This role offers an exciting opportunity to support the top management and prepare our engineering for the future by implementing the latest design tools (incl. AI) in an international environment, contributing to the continuous improvement and evolution of our exciting products. In your job you will be able to bring in your creative solutions. You will be coached by experienced experts and top management of our company.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation.
- Partial mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Europe (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Assist in Transformation and Change projects for an international engineering function.
- Assist in the creation, preparation, documentation of workshops, events and roadshows for the leadership team and the engineering teams.
- Support the communication to the teams with creative formats (e.g. podcasts,...).
- Contribute to analyzing the effectiveness of the transformation initatives and identify gaps.
- Support the creation of inspiring presentations.
- Support in operative and administrative tasks.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering and Management, Work & Organizational Psychology, Human Resource, or a comparable degree program.
- Knowledge of—and ideally experience with—G Suite applications and Artificial Intelligence.
- Ideally, knowledge of and experience with Change Management.
- Strong interest in digital technologies and their application.
- Ability to work independently.
- Language skills: Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a strong advantage.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
