You work closely with engineering, suppliers, customers, and cross-functional project teams to deliver gas turbine auxiliary systems. Your day includes creating and updating engineering documentation, supporting project execution activities, and coordinating technical interfaces with internal and external stakeholders. You also contribute to the digitalization of engineering processes, support colleagues using SAP S/4HANA engineering-related modules, and ensure project requirements, quality standards, and supplier deliverables are met throughout the project lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for customer order engineering activities for gas turbine auxiliary systems
* Creation and maintenance of piping and instrumentation diagrams as well as preparation of engineering documentation, specifications, drawings, data sheets, and parts lists
* Support of data-driven project execution methods and implementation of digitalized engineering processes across multiple teams
* Provision of user support for engineering-related SAP S/4HANA applications and continuous process improvement initiatives
* Coordination of suppliers for engineering and manufacturing activities, including progress monitoring, quality assurance, documentation review, and acceptance inspections
* Clarification and coordination of technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, site personnel, engineering partners, and internal stakeholders

What You Bring

* Degree in process engineering, mechanical engineering, plant engineering, or a comparable engineering discipline, combined with professional experience in project execution
* Experience in at least one relevant engineering field and a strong understanding of engineering project environments
* More than 2 years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, including basic knowledge of Materials Management (MM) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
* Passion for process simplification, automation, digitalization, and openness to new technologies and modern ways of working
* Analytical mindset, structured working approach, and ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, very good English language proficiency, and willingness to develop innovative solutions in interdisciplinary teams 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

- Start: Immediately
- Duration: Approx. 12 months

Around 60% of the value of the Airbus Products comes from our external supply chain, composed from thousands of suppliers all over the world. The Procurement function is therefore a key contributor to the sustainable profitability and to the technical innovation of Airbus.

Definition working student
Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.
This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.
Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

jobs.description:
Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.

Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology.
 

Your Impact

The structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.

You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.

What You'll Do

Design & Improve Structural Systems

- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.
- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.
- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.
- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.

Lead Material & Component Testing

- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.
- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.
- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.
- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.

Develop & Validate Engineering Models

- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.
- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.
- Validate simulation results through physical testing.
- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.
- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.
- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.
- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).
- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.
- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.
- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.
- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.
- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.
- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.
- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.
- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.
- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.
What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.
 
We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.
 

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Digital Payload Processors Design Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) for Development of AI models for Spacecraft FDIR

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a AI Engineer for space systems?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in Digital Payload Processors as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn, near Munich
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: min. 6 months, or longer

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

You will support the Digital Payload Processors Team to develop new, enhanced AI models for autonomous Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) tasks.

- Exploration of AI architectures for best results in accordance with the input data.
- Performing trade off analysis of AI models based on key performance indices.
- Developing strategies to integrate AI models with other spacecraft subsystems.
- Exploration of methodologies and techniques on the path of efficient AI implementation chain.
- Implementation of tests to validate the AI models to ensure reliability and performance.
- Documentation of processes and results.
- Assist in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to development.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m), in a relevant degree program (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Engineering, Aerospace Engineering).
- Strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Neural Networks modeling frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), preferably with experience in data engineering.
- Good signal processing background.
- Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C++).
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.
- Fluent English is mandatory (written and spoken); German would be an asset.
- Experience of neural network inference on embedded processing platforms (CPU, FPGA) is a plus.
- Knowledge of spacecraft systems is a plus.
- You are a good team player, have excellent communication skills, and are able to work independently.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Your tasks and responsibilities, Scope of Master’s Thesis

6G / 5G is giving the convergence of terrestrial and satellite-based networks a major boost. Under the keyword "Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)", satellites are being consistently integrated into the mobile communications standard for the first time, subsequently paving the way for a global and dense communication network in the future 6G generation.

Due to the inherent conditions of wireless communication – and particularly with the deployment of open standards and vast coverage areas – the threat posed by jammers and spoofers is ubiquitous. Specifically at the physical layer, the detection and suppression of malicious signals constitute an enormous challenge that must be overcome to ensure the integrity of the network.

The Master’s Thesis position will support the ongoing R&D activities on on-board implementation and scaling of a jamming robust gNodeB. The successful candidate shall contribute to one or more of the following fields:

- Sequence Analysis: Investigating the mathematical and statistical properties of different sequence designs in the context of NTN-specific channel conditions.
- Attack Modeling: Developing simulation models for various pilot-spoofing and jamming scenarios to evaluate their impact on signal integrity.
- Robustness Characterization: Analyzing how different sequence properties react to malicious interference through various performance metrics.
- Feature Identification: Identifying unique "signal signatures" or features that can be used to distinguish between legitimate and spoofed signals.
- Benchmark Development: Providing a comparative evaluation of sequence-based robustness to support the development of on-board detection algorithms.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student in Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Strong foundation in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Communication Theory
- Proficiency in scripting and simulation using MATLAB or Python
- Basic understanding of OFDM waveforms
- Familiarity with communication standards (e.g., 3GPP, 6G/5G, or CCSDS) is a plus
- Excellent written and spoken English for technical documentation and communication; German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Mission Systems Equipment Design Responsible (d/f/m)

Your Mission

As Equipment Design Responsible, you will be the technical authority for airborne equipment throughout its entire lifecycle, for various weapon systems. You will transform operational and system-level needs into robust, certifiable equipment solutions, working closely with international suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. You will ensure that equipment designs meet demanding performance, qualification, and certification requirements while supporting integration, testing and in-service operations. This role offers a unique combination of design responsibility, technical depth and direct influence on the successful delivery of advanced airborne capabilities.

Your location (Manching)

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeterias, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Networking and connection: Employee events, groups and initiatives
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Own the technical responsibility of airborne mission systems equipment throughout the full development lifecycle, including in-service support activities.
- Preparation and validation of Equipment technical specification and other contractual documents. Managing equipment requirements from higher-level system architecture and customer specifications down to equipment-level allocation.
- Technical management of suppliers of airborne equipment: technical evaluation, design and qualification follow up, milestones management, stages of involvement, validation and acceptance of deliverables, management of limitations and deviations, support to defect investigations and repairs, harmonization and control of supplier and program plans.
- Review technical solutions, challenge design decisions when necessary, and support issue resolution during development and integration phases.
- Ensure compliance with applicable aeronautical and contractual standards and certification requirements (e.g. DO-254) during the design and qualification, repair, obsolescence and re-design activities.
- Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities with internal specialists (safety, EMC, environmental qualification, RM&T, Quality, ILS, Airworthiness,…).
- Interface with customers, partner companies and certification authorities for technical matters related to equipment functionalities, design, qualification and problem resolution.
- Monitoring and support of the subsequent Equipment Integration including Sub-system, system verification and flight tests.
- Support requests concerning Equipment queries, in service occurrence reports and defect investigations.

Your Profile:

- (Master) Degree in electronics/electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent
- At least 3-5 years of professional experience
- Strong technical background in electronic equipment development: embedded electronics (Microcontrollers, FPGAs, ASICs,... ), mission computers, high-speed digital interfaces, video or data processing systems, real-time embedded architecture,...
- Knowledge and practical expertise with airborne equipment:
- Qualification and certification
- Hardware development/design and verification (e.g. DO-254, ARP4754A, AMC 20-152A, DO-160, MIL-STD-810)
- Software development (DO-178) is considered a plus
- Ability to technically assess supplier solutions and support problem-solving activities during development
- Experience in technical supplier management is a plus
- Experience in requirements engineering and requirements management tools (DOORs) is a plus
- Comfortable taking ownership and making technical decisions
- Strong communication skills and ability to interact with suppliers, customers and authorities in an international environment
- Teamplayer and comfortable in international and multidisciplinary engineering environment: demonstrated skills to work independently and in a collaboratively manner within an international team, including the ability to coordinate and influence people
- Business-fluent English, German is a plus
- Willingness to travel internationally to supplier facilities and customer sites when required

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

As a Data Governance Specialist with a focus on Data Governance Audit and Assurance, you are part of our growing Data Governance team within our Digital Core function, where we work together on supporting the wider needs and demands from the business, transforming the way we think of data and embedding data management in our key deliveries across all areas of the energy industry. In this fast-paced environment, you will assist your team in the formation and execution of the data governance framework, policy, standards; with particular focus on designing and implementing a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers, and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement. This role will also contribute to data governance enablement activities to make data accountability real; in this manner you will contribute to the execution of data governance framework, policy, standards. As a valued member of the Data Governance team, you will assist in the operationalisation of our enterprise data governance efforts to truly bring data governance alive at Siemens Energy.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact
* Design and implement a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement
* Automate this framework making it user friendly so that it can be understood by our stakeholders and embraced into execution; leveraging our Data Governance tools, such as Data Catalog and Data Quality, and building upon our SE data governance processes  
* Communicate data governance concepts effectively and facilitate training to enable and operationalize the data management roles in the organization 
* Design, deliver and execute (baseline) data maturity assessments, along with other data governance controls or mechanisms, ensuring ongoing monitoring, alignment with targets (where applicable) and remediation actions  
* Create and refine policies, procedures, and guidelines to mature the concept of data governance and the practices around data management across Siemens Energy; and align them where applicable to the audit and assurance framework. 
* Engage with data stakeholders through the Data Governance forums and regular touch-points to formalize decisions and plans on data governance audit and assurance practices. including data maturity review cycles, gain their buy-in and follow-up on tracking and reporting of maturity improvements and targets
* Support the development and maintenance of an end-to-end data lifecycle management approach; leverage the Data Management Enterprise Process and Data FAIR process and make sure our framework for data governance audit and assurance builds upon the enterprise data management practices 
* Collaborate with the wider Data Governance team, Digital Core and the business; for the framework to be a successful collaboration endorsed and adopted by all; reinforcing the team efforts on establishing commons ways of working, adoption of the data governance metamodel, production of reusable governed data products and availability of AI-ready data

What You Bring
* University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Information Technologies or a related field. Experience with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, Informatica Data Catalog, Collibra Data Quality and Observability platform or similar products. 
* Extensive proven experience in embedding Data Governance and Data Management in a large organization (preferably), particularly in designing, planning and executing audit and assurance controls in complex environments; therefore, guiding the business through the process, supporting them with recommendations and enabling them to act upon the findings. 
* Specialist in designing and implementing Data Governance; has experience or very good understanding of Master and Reference Data Management, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, Enterprise Data architecture and Data security practices. 
* Proven facilitation skills to drive progress and resolve issues within large data governance programs, with expert understanding of existing data management frameworks, tools and best practices and ability to pragmatically apply these 
* Strong communication and change management skills: able to explain technical concepts to business colleagues in plain language and naturally incorporate change management activities in the rollout of any data governance capability. Fluent in both written and spoken English

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our Computer Vision Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Mission Systems

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of our Computer Vision team? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Juli 2026
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Germany is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.

As a Customs Specialist (f/m/d), you ensure that customs-related processes run smoothly, efficiently, and in full compliance with applicable regulations. You combine hands-on operational customs activities with contributions to governance, compliance, harmonization, and process improvement initiatives across the four Business Areas in Germany.
In this role, you collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, customs authorities, external service providers, and international customs colleagues to ensure aligned and compliant import and export operations. Through your monitoring and expertise, you help ensure that procedures are executed correctly, documentation meets all legal requirements, and potential risks are identified and mitigated early.
As part of the Customs Region Europe network, you support the integration of regulatory changes into daily operations and contribute to continuous process improvements. Your work strengthens compliance, ensures audit readiness, and enhances the overall effectiveness of customs operations.
Your digital mindset is highly valued—innovative ideas and digital solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and standardization are always welcome.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Execute and oversee daily import and export customs activities, including documentation review, tariff classification, preference determination, and customs value validation.
* Prepare and validate customs documentation and ensure accurate and timely submissions to customs authorities while maintaining master data in SAP S/4HANA or MIC.
* Ensure compliance with national, EU, and international customs regulations and support internal and external customs audits.
* Monitor regulatory changes and contribute to the implementation of compliance measures and internal control requirements (ICP Europe).
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Export Control, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT, and Country Customs Responsibles.
* Drive process improvements, standardization, and digitalization initiatives while supporting strategic customs projects across the organization.

What You Bring

* Completed degree or vocational qualification in Customs, International Trade, Business Administration, Law, or a comparable field.
* Several years of professional experience in customs operations, including import/export procedures, tariff classification, customs valuation, and preferential origin.
* Solid knowledge of EU customs regulations; experience working across multiple European countries is an advantage.

As an Engineering & Innovation Manager for the Gas Services Solutions business, you could imagine beginning your day by aligning cross‑functional teams and key stakeholders - internal functions and partners - around modularization and innovation priorities across the full EPC lifecycle. Throughout the day, you drive modularization workshops with multi-disciplinary engineering teams, support benchmarking competitor offerings, shape innovation business cases, and cocreate concepts with diverse collaborators to accelerate idea maturity. You wrap up by steering pilot projects toward scalable, standardized offerings that strengthen the future energy portfolio.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Drive modularization, standardization & innovation initiatives by being involved in complete EPC (Erection, Procurement, Construction) lifecycle of complex power plants and hybrid solutions
* Lead and integrate cross-functional teams, esp. interfacing with diverse engineering fields (e.g., electrical, controls & instrumentation, process, mechanical, plant layout, etc.), and collaborate across organizational boundaries to advance innovation concepts towards maturity
* Benchmark competitor offerings and prototype unconventional approaches; validate business model viability and commercialization paths
* Ability to manage the future of energy by interacting with external partners (customers, consultants, suppliers) and internal collaborators, to identify, prioritize and drive new ideas

What You Bring

* University degree (Bc or MSc) in engineering and substantial experience in power plant engineering, solution innovation, product strategy, or portfolio management within the energy or industrial project environment
* Ability to create cost models, develop business cases, pilot new ideas, and scale innovations into standardized offerings
* Knowledge of design thinking, modularization, and analytical and financial evaluation methods
* Leadership through influence across functions such as engineering, bid management, supply chain, and finance
* Persistent and experimental mindset with the ability to challenge established approaches and collaborate across organizational boundaries
* Business fluency in English (C1) and German (C1) as well as a readiness for global collaboration with limited travel as required for workshops and discussions

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines are under one roof, alongside steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities are enabled through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards / Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an employer-financed company pension scheme.
* Opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder.
* Flexible and remote working options, supported by inspiring office environments for collaboration and creativity.
* Strong focus on professional and personal development with access to various learning programs and materials.
* Wide range of family-supporting offers such as flexible working time models, childcare options at many locations, trial part-time work, or sabbaticals.

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Digital Governance Specialist at Siemens Energy, you navigate the convergence of German co-determination law (BetrVG) and the EU AI Act – two frameworks that create a dual compliance trigger for every AI-enabled system deployed in the workplace. From M365 Copilot to S/4HANA analytics, you assess each initiative against § 87 BetrVG and the EU AI Act’s high-risk classification, lead works agreement (Betriebsvereinbarung) negotiations, facilitate the interface to the Technology Committee process end-to-end, and ensure compliance with our company obligations (e.g. Art. 26 EU AI Act). Bridging HR, Legal, external counsel, and IT project teams, you enable Siemens Energy to deploy digital technologies and AI responsibly and at pace.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Works Council Intake and Enablement Process: Establish and own the process through which all IT teams, IT Project Managers, and IT Service Owners channel their works council clarification needs. Act as the single gateway between the broader Digital Core organization and the works council, triaging incoming requests, assessing co-determination relevance, and ensuring no IT initiative engages the works council without proper preparation and coordination through this role
* Dual-Framework AI Governance: Operate the “double trigger” assessment – BetrVG § 87 co-determination and EU AI Act Annex III high-risk classification (employment/worker management). Ensure compliance with Art. 5 prohibited practices and Art. 26 deployer obligations (worker notification, human oversight, log retention)
* Works Council Agreement Management: Own the 90-day co-determination approval process for IT services rolled out to Germany, conducting trigger assessments and steering each initiative through the two-track path (Technology Committee protocol or group works agreement)
* Technology Committee Management: Manage the 6-step process from HR engagement through committee presentation (in German, per defined template), group works council negotiation, to general works council approval. Coordinate external counsel, manage feature freezes, and produce executive summaries for CIO reporting
* Stakeholder Management and Change Enablement: Unify BetrVG and EU AI Act governance across HR, Legal, Data Privacy, and IT. Implement Art. 26(7) worker notification for high-risk AI deployments, drive AI literacy programs, and develop communication plans for major feature rollouts

What You Bring

* University degree in Law, Business Informatics, or Human Resources, preferably with experience in collaboration with German works councils for IT topics
* Working knowledge in relevant regulatory requirements (e.g. BetrVG § 87, Leistungs-/Verhaltenskontrolle, EU AI Act)
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with experience facilitating committee sessions, coordinating external counsel, and managing co-determination workflows across HR, IT, and works council stakeholders
* Solid understanding of key digital technologies relevant for Siemens Energy (e.g. Microsoft M365, SAP, Teamcenter, SalesForce, Copilot), and AI/GenAI concepts, with the ability to assess how embedded AI features trigger both BetrVG and EU AI Act obligations
* Fluency in both German and English is mandatory. Native-level German required for collaboration with German works council presentations, negotiations, and all agreement documentation

Join the Digital Governance team within Siemens Energy’s Digital Core (DC DTO) at a pivotal moment: BetrVG and the EU AI Act are converging, with high-risk AI enforcement starting August 2026. This role owns co-determination approvals while building EU AI Act compliance capabilities, working with HR as the exclusive interface to the General Works Council’s Technology Committee.

jobs.occupation: Working Student within Web App Development and Implementation (d/f/m) (Web Developer)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Innovation department in Customer Services (SDI), Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a

Working Student within Web App Development and Implementation (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of Airbus?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Innovation department in Customer Services (SDI) as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ottobrunn
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Limited mobile working is possible after ramp-up phase and after agreement with the department
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Development of a smart chatbot
- Integration of the smart chatbot into a web-based demonstration app for the real time air traffic analytics capabilities and implementation for mobile use. The required integration development is based on an already existing initial version of the app.
- Where required for the integration and full exploitation of the smart chatbot complement the existing feature set of the web app.
- Interface with our DevOps team on cutting edge real time aviation data using the latest in big data, machine learning and cloud technologies.
- In return for a high level of independence and engagement in your working style we offer room for your own creativity and development ideas.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full time student within Information Science or similar field of study
- hands-on experience in web app development (demonstration examples of previous own developments welcome!)
- hands-on experience in implementation of Chatbot functionalities, generative AI, language models would be a plus (demonstration examples of previous own developments welcome!)
- proficiency in at least one contemporary web framework, preferably React or similar
- knowledge of backend technologies (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, NodeJS)
- experience with databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka) and understanding of how to interact with them using queries and APIs
- understanding on specificities of implementation of mobile (progressive) web apps
- mastery of UI/UX needs and access ergonomics would be a plus
- experience in graphic design principles and implementation would be a plus
- initiative, creativity and independent way of working
- English: fluent mandatory
- German: optional

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Landing Gear System (LGS) Centre of Competence (CoC), Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a work student to act as:

Working Student - Landing Gear System Engineering Project Control Assistant (d/f/m)

Are you are a full time student, looking for a working student position (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the LGS CoC as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 12 months

Working Student Definition

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support to planning and control of LGS (Landing Gear System) structural and rolling Stock development projects.
- Support to internal configuration control and document traceability activities.
- Document and archive management activities.
- Support to generation of LGS technical and programme-related reports, instructions and memoranda.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or an equivalent field of study.
- Advanced user, MS Office suite – MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Advanced verbal and written English skills; German language skills would be beneficial.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrolment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and applyonline (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

Your day starts by reviewing fresh market and competitor insights to refine the portfolio narratives for each priority market. Before lunch, you sync with regional Sales to calibrate pricing and packaging for upcoming opportunities, then brief Product Marketing on messaging adjustments. In the afternoon, you co‑create sales enablement assets (playbooks, case studies, demo scripts) and run a short stand‑up with cross‑functional stakeholders to track launch readiness and KPI progress. You close the day by analyzing adoption/funnel data and proposing optimizations to GTM tactics for the next sprint.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Conduct continuous market research and competitive analysis to pinpoint target segments, use‑cases, and buying centers for automation software
* Define clear portfolio descriptions per market and craft a differentiated value proposition and messaging that address customer pain points
* Build and manage comprehensive launch plans for new products/features and market expansions—covering timelines, budgets, enablement workstreams, and channel/distribution motions
* Orchestrate regional rollout calendars and campaign sequences; maintain an integrated GTM roadmap aligned with PLM gates and executive priorities
* Act as the central coordination point across Product, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Service to ensure unified execution and feedback loops
* Facilitate decision‑ready forums and ensure GTM inputs/outputs are recorded in core lifecycle artifacts and checklists
* Partner with content creators to deliver sales‑ready materials (playbooks, case studies, white papers, demo scripts, ROI calculators, objection‑handling guides)
* Maintain a Sales Kit repository and ensure content continuously reflects portfolio updates, regional proof‑points, and competitive positioning
* Own regional pricing strategy, including packaging, discount guardrails, and deal‑desk guidelines; pilot localized offers with Sales and Product
* Define market positioning per segment/region, balancing visibility, adoption velocity, and margin goals; partner with Product on value‑based pricing models
* Establish and monitor KPIs such as feature adoption, qualified pipeline, win rate, conversion velocity, average selling price, CAC, and ARR growth
* Drive data‑driven optimizations to messaging, channel mix, and pricing; publish regular GTM performance reviews and recommendations

What You Bring

* Proven long term experience in B2B software GTM, product/portfolio marketing, or pricing—ideally in industrial automation, grid automation, or energy software markets
* Hands‑on with TAM/SAM/SOM sizing, competitor tear‑downs, win/loss, and voice‑of‑customer programs; ability to convert insights into precise portfolio narratives per market
* Proven record designing regional pricing strategies (list/packaging, promotions, guardrails) and coordinating deal‑desk decisions
* Strong storytelling and content development skills; you can enable Sales with persuasive collateral and repeatable talk‑tracks
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management; comfortable running cross‑functional cadences and aligning diverse teams
* Familiarity with GTM dashboards (adoption, funnel, revenue), experimentation (A/B), and hypothesis‑driven optimization
* Experience working within PLM stage‑gates and GTM checklists; agile marketing or product operations exposure is a plus

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the sustainability ambition and journey at Airbus Defence and Space we are looking for a

Working student in Sustainability and Business Development (d/f/m)

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to explore how to be a sustainability ambassador (d/f/m) and create impact_?_  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Sustainability team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Ottobrunn
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- to contribute to the Sustainability Ambition and Roadmap plan and support the implementation of concrete actions.
- to support our impact innovation activities with market analysis and business models/business development activities.
- Support ecosystem and business development activities in wildfire fighting and sustainable aviation fuel.
- to support the management and participate to dedicated projects actively.
- to support on measuring performance of our domain within Airbus Defence and Space.
- Further we aim to inspire people to integrate sustainability in the business by being role models.
- to assist the team in employee engagement, prepare and help in communication (e.g. taking care of our Newsletter and maintaining our Google Site).

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of sustainability management, environmental science, business studies, economics, communications, engineering or an equivalent field of study.
- You have a proficiency level in Google Suite.
- You already have some previous experience or deep interest in the field of Sustainability (would be a plus) and business development.
- You have experience in business modeling and business case analysis.
- You are creative and enjoy developing new ideas and concepts.
- You are highly motivated and interested in sustainability and have a "can-do" attitude.
- You have a structured working approach and lots of initiative.
- You have good project management skills.
- Your English is Fluent; German Proficiency would be a plus.
- You are a good team player, have excellent communication skills, and are able to work independently.
- Most important, you have strong sense of ownership and responsibility.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Siemens Energy operates a comprehensive Global HR Platform with a mix of standard and custom-built applications. We are looking for a Technical Product Owner (f/m/d) to take end-to-end responsibility for a specific functional area (e.g., Compensation & Benefits, Org Management, or Contracts).
You will operate at the intersection of strategy, business, and technology. Working in close alignment with the Global Platform Owner, you will act as a key partner for the HR Centers of Competence (CoCs), consulting them on processes and feasibility, before translating their needs into clear technical requirements for the Development Team.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Module Ownership & Alignment: You own the roadmap for your assigned module(s). You ensure your specific features align with the overall architectural strategy set by the Global Platform Owner
* Consulting the CoCs (Centers of Competence): You act as a technical advisor (f/m/d) to the HR experts. You don't just "take orders"; you consult the CoCs on how to map their business requirements into a scalable, generic software logic. You challenge complexity and advocate for standard solutions
* Generic & Modular Thinking: You ensure that requirements from the CoCs are not built as "one-off" solutions. You design reusable components that serve the global organization, keeping the custom landscape maintainable and efficient
* Translation to Development: You are the link to the engine room. You translate complex business concepts from the CoCs into precise User Stories, Epics, and technical specifications that the Development Team can implement without ambiguity
* Professionalization & Lifecycle: You drive the "Evolution" of your area. You manage the backlog, prioritize features based on business value, and ensure the software remains compliant and robust
* Stakeholder Management: You manage the expectations of diverse stakeholders, balancing the functional wishes of the CoCs with the technical realities and capacity of the Dev Team

What You Bring
* Professional Background: A degree in Computer Science, IT, or related fields, with a strong professional background in Software Engineering or Solution Architecture.
* The "Architect" Mindset: You have experience in professionalizing homegrown software. You understand how to build generic, reusable logic rather than hard-coding business exceptions.
* Consulting Experience: You are comfortable working with non-technical business experts (CoCs). You can explain technical constraints clearly and guide them toward the best solution.
* Collaboration Skills: You have experience working in a triangular setup: aligning with a Product/Platform Owner, serving Business Stakeholders, and steering a Development Team.
* Domain Knowledge: Experience with HR processes (Compensation, Org Mgmt, etc.) is a plus, but your ability to structure complex logic is the priority.

Master student in the field of Supportability Engineering (d/f/m), title of thesis “Machine Learning based Pattern recognition”

You are looking for a master thesis? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Supportability Engineering team as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Manching
- Start: 01.11.2025
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Thesis Topic

The work includes the definition, implementation, and evaluation of suitable machine learning models for analysing and classifying diagnostic patterns based on historical or simulated data from real-world testability use cases.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Analyse and preprocess diagnostic data from test systems
- Identify characteristic failure patterns and symptom relationships
- Define and compare suitable model architectures for fault detection and isolation (e.g. decision trees, ensemble models, neural networks, clustering approaches, etc.)
- Train and validate models using established ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and MATLAB Simulink (e.g. Artificial Intelligence (AI))
- Evaluate model performance using metrics such as detection rate, false alarm rate, and isolation accuracy
- Integrate your approach into an existing analysis pipeline or tool environment
- Document and present your results to stakeholders

Desired skills and qualifications

- Full time enrolled student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field
- Solid understanding of machine learning concepts and data preprocessing
- Practical experience with MATLAB Simulink and ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
- Programming skills (e.g. Python)
- Interest in fault detection, diagnostics, and system testability
- Analytical mindset, structured working style, and ability to work independently
- Basic knowledge of test or diagnostic systems (e.g. FMEA/FMECA) is a plus
- Language skills: English fluent; French basic knowledge

jobs.description:
To support our initiatives for further adoption of Philips technology providing Class IA guideline treatment options, we are expanding our International marketing team with a Business Marketing Manager DACH, responsible for the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio.

The Business Marketing Manager is the dedicated field-based marketing owner for the DACH market zone, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This role is accountable for translating international and global marketing strategy into locally relevant market activation, demand generation and adoption across the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio. The individual is expected to operate close to the market, spending significant time in the field with sales teams, customers, clinical partners and regional stakeholders to understand local needs, identify growth opportunities and remove barriers to execution.

The role combines strategic portfolio marketing with hands-on field execution. The Business Marketing Manager will define and drive DACH-specific marketing plans, shape customer engagement programs, support priority account activation, build local proof points and ensure launches, campaigns and market development initiatives are executed with strong local relevance and commercial impact.

As a member of the International Marketing team, you will own specific marketing activities that span the complete international region.

Success in this role requires regular travel and visible presence across the zone. The individual should expect to travel extensively within DACH, approximately 50-60% of time, to engage with customers, KOLs, sales teams, professional societies, congresses, workshops and other in-market activation opportunities.

Your role:

Own the DACH market zone

- Act as the primary marketing owner for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, accountable for local market planning, activation priorities and execution quality. Be present in the field with sales team, and customers to understand adoption barriers, customer needs, competetive dynamics and local growth opportunities.
- Collaborate with global and international marketing, market intelligence, and sales leadership to prioritise target accounts, market segments, and growth opportunities across the portfolio.
- Lead specific marketing capabilities internationally, strengthening the broader International marketing organization.
- Translate strategy into local execution by converting global and international portfolio strategies into DACH-specific messaging, campaigns, engagement formats and sales enablement priorities.
- Drive demand generation and adoption by leading marketing activities that increase awareness, utilization and customer preference for the full IGTD portfolio.

Partner internally, externally and represent the voice of the market

- Partner with sales leadership and field teams to prioritize accounts, shape plans, refine messaging and support commercial objectives.
- Bring structured market insights, customer feedback and competitive intelligence back to the international marketing team to influence activation planning and portfolio priorities.
- Seek and develop opportunities to strengthen Philips’ cardiology value proposition for customers in your region by close partnership with adjacent Philips categories such as the One-IGT unique solution offering.
- Build reference sites, customer testimonials, and clinical proof points that resonate with local audiences. Partner with KOLs and professional societies to strengthen Philips’ position in focus markets.
- Work under limited supervision and broad guidelines, serving as the primary marketing contact for assigned portfolio areas and focus markets.
- Define proposals for the mid-term marketing strategy, identifying key market challenges and opportunities early and implementing business plans and goals accordingly.

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare, or related field.

- Must be fluent in German and English languages.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is € 126,297.80 – € 159,977.21. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you will have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We will share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application as a single PDF by 5 October 2026, including:

- CV
- Letter of motivation
- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials
- Two relevant publications
- Contact details of two potential references

Please compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

The position is embedded in EU-MIC (European Coalition for Mental Health Medicines Innovation), a strategic initiative led by the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology (ECNP). EU-MIC aims to address the growing innovation gap in psychopharmacology between Europe and the United States and to examine the structural disparities between mental and somatic health in access to innovative medicines.

A major workstream of the project focuses on the quantification of the direct and indirect societal costs of mental disorders, including:

- healthcare and treatment costs
- sick leave, retirement and disability-related costs
- productivity losses
- presenteeism and absenteeism
- broader social and long-term economic consequences

The resulting evidence will contribute to scientific publications, European policy reports, and advocacy activities targeting regulators, HTA bodies, payers, policymakers, clinicians, patients, and carers.

The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extending it to three years. There is also the opportunity to pursue a habilitation.

Your Role:

- Develop and implement a health-economic data analysis plan within EU-MIC
- Identify, collate, harmonise, and analyse national and international datasets (which, in part, will also be delivered by the supporting companies) and evidence sources
- Model direct and indirect costs of mental disorders across European healthcare systems
- Quantify presenteeism, productivity losses, and wider societal economic impacts
- Conduct systematic evidence reviews, evidence synthesis, and health-economic modelling
- Establish transparent data structures, metadata standards, and reproducible analytical workflows
- Prepare peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, policy briefs, and stakeholder presentations
- Collaborate closely with international experts in psychiatry, health economics, HTA, public affairs, and patient organisations
- Contribute to the strategic development of EU-MIC and future European research and funding initiatives
